+result("toy scalar at bound minus one", `production_private_key: ${(2n ** 32n - 1n).toString(16).padStart(64, "0")}\n`);
+result("cited round-one fixture", `production_private_key: ${CITED_VECTORS.at(-1)!.value}\n`);

+import { mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
+import { join } from "node:path";
+import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
+import { encodeSeed } from "ripple-address-codec";
+
+const root = process.argv[2];
+const gate = "$USER_TMP/T/x.ROpM8B/repo/tools/check-no-secrets.ts";
+const env = { ...process.env, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1", GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: "/dev/null", GIT_AUTHOR_NAME: "probe", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME: "probe", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid" };
+const sh = (cmd: string[], cwd = root) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(cmd, { cwd, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  if (r.exitCode !== 0) throw new Error(`${cmd.join(" ")} (${r.exitCode}): ${new TextDecoder().decode(r.stderr)}`);
+  return new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).trim();
+};
+const git = (repo: string, ...args: string[]) => sh(["git", "-C", repo, ...args]);
+const init = (name: string) => { const p = join(root, name); mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true }); git(p, "init", "-q", "-b", "main"); return p; };
+const commit = (repo: string, msg = "probe") => { git(repo, "add", "-A"); git(repo, "commit", "-q", "--no-gpg-sign", "-m", msg); };
+const gateRun = (name: string, repo: string, args: string[]) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(["bun", "run", gate, "--repo", repo, ...args, "--no-local-store"], { cwd: repo, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  const lines = new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).split("\n").filter((l) => /^(REFUSED:|FAILING:|scanned:|check-no-secrets:)/.test(l));
+  console.log(`${name}: process-exit=${r.exitCode}; ${lines.join(" | ")}`);
+};
+
+rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
+mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });
+
+const filterEq = init("filter-equals");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("filter= tree", filterEq, ["--tree-only"]);
+commit(filterEq);
+gateRun("filter= rev", filterEq, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const filterBare = init("filter-bare");
+git(filterBare, "config", "filter.set.clean", "sed 's/.*/SAFE/'");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter\n");
+const filteredSeed = encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, "payload.txt"), `${filteredSeed}\n`);
+console.log(`bare filter check-attr: ${git(filterBare, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+commit(filterBare);
+console.log(`bare filter committed payload: ${git(filterBare, "show", "HEAD:payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("bare filter rev", filterBare, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const attrComment = init("attr-comment");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, ".gitattributes"), "# Documentation example: *.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(attrComment);
+console.log(`comment check-attr: ${git(attrComment, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("comment-only attribute rev", attrComment, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const replace = init("replace");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519")}\n`);
+commit(replace);
+const original = git(replace, "rev-parse", "HEAD:f.txt");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const safe = git(replace, "hash-object", "-w", "f.txt");
+git(replace, "replace", original, safe);
+gateRun("replace rev", replace, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("replace history", replace, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const tab = init("tab");
+mkdirSync(join(tab, "a\tb"));
+writeFileSync(join(tab, "a\tb", "state.json"), "{}\n");
+commit(tab);
+gateRun("tab rev", tab, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("tab history", tab, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const child = init("child");
+writeFileSync(join(child, "child.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(child);
+const superRepo = init("ordinary-submodule");
+git(superRepo, "-c", "protocol.file.allow=always", "submodule", "add", "-q", child, "vendor/sub");
+commit(superRepo);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule tree", superRepo, ["--tree-only"]);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule rev", superRepo, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const nested = init("nested");
+writeFileSync(join(nested, "top.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const inner = join(nested, "inner");
+mkdirSync(inner);
+git(inner, "init", "-q", "-b", "main");
+writeFileSync(join(inner, "inside.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("untracked nested tree", nested, ["--tree-only"]);
+
+const hist = init("history");
+writeFileSync(join(hist, "gone.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "secp256k1")}\n`);
+commit(hist, "secret old");
+rmSync(join(hist, "gone.txt"));
+commit(hist, "safe head");
+const head = git(hist, "rev-parse", "HEAD");
+const graftPath = git(hist, "rev-parse", "--git-path", "info/grafts");
+writeFileSync(join(hist, graftPath), `${head}\n`);
+gateRun("grafts history", hist, ["--history-only"]);

+  const hits = scanText(text, empty);
+  console.log(`${name}: findings=${hits.filter((h) => !h.allowedBy).length} allowed=${hits.filter((h) => h.allowedBy).map((h) => h.allowedBy).join(" | ") || "none"}`);
+};

+result("bob path", "[synthetic personal-path redacted]/client/ledger.txt\n");

+import { mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
+import { join } from "node:path";
+import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
+import { encodeSeed } from "ripple-address-codec";
+
+const root = process.argv[2];
+const gate = "$USER_TMP/T/x.ROpM8B/repo/tools/check-no-secrets.ts";
+const env = { ...process.env, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1", GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: "/dev/null", GIT_AUTHOR_NAME: "probe", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME: "probe", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid" };
+const sh = (cmd: string[], cwd = root) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(cmd, { cwd, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  if (r.exitCode !== 0) throw new Error(`${cmd.join(" ")} (${r.exitCode}): ${new TextDecoder().decode(r.stderr)}`);
+  return new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).trim();
+};
+const git = (repo: string, ...args: string[]) => sh(["git", "-C", repo, ...args]);
+const init = (name: string) => { const p = join(root, name); mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true }); git(p, "init", "-q", "-b", "main"); return p; };
+const commit = (repo: string, msg = "probe") => { git(repo, "add", "-A"); git(repo, "commit", "-q", "--no-gpg-sign", "-m", msg); };
+const gateRun = (name: string, repo: string, args: string[]) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(["bun", "run", gate, "--repo", repo, ...args, "--no-local-store"], { cwd: repo, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  const lines = new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).split("\n").filter((l) => /^(REFUSED:|FAILING:|scanned:|check-no-secrets:)/.test(l));
+  console.log(`${name}: process-exit=${r.exitCode}; ${lines.join(" | ")}`);
+};
+
+rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
+mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });
+
+const filterEq = init("filter-equals");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("filter= tree", filterEq, ["--tree-only"]);
+commit(filterEq);
+gateRun("filter= rev", filterEq, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const filterBare = init("filter-bare");
+git(filterBare, "config", "filter.set.clean", "sed 's/.*/SAFE/'");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter\n");
+const filteredSeed = encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, "payload.txt"), `${filteredSeed}\n`);
+console.log(`bare filter check-attr: ${git(filterBare, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+commit(filterBare);
+console.log(`bare filter committed payload: ${git(filterBare, "show", "HEAD:payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("bare filter rev", filterBare, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const attrComment = init("attr-comment");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, ".gitattributes"), "# Documentation example: *.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(attrComment);
+console.log(`comment check-attr: ${git(attrComment, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("comment-only attribute rev", attrComment, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const replace = init("replace");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519")}\n`);
+commit(replace);
+const original = git(replace, "rev-parse", "HEAD:f.txt");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const safe = git(replace, "hash-object", "-w", "f.txt");
+git(replace, "replace", original, safe);
+gateRun("replace rev", replace, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("replace history", replace, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const tab = init("tab");
+mkdirSync(join(tab, "a\tb"));
+writeFileSync(join(tab, "a\tb", "state.json"), "{}\n");
+commit(tab);
+gateRun("tab rev", tab, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("tab history", tab, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const child = init("child");
+writeFileSync(join(child, "child.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(child);
+const superRepo = init("ordinary-submodule");
+git(superRepo, "-c", "protocol.file.allow=always", "submodule", "add", "-q", child, "vendor/sub");
+commit(superRepo);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule tree", superRepo, ["--tree-only"]);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule rev", superRepo, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const nested = init("nested");
+writeFileSync(join(nested, "top.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const inner = join(nested, "inner");
+mkdirSync(inner);
+git(inner, "init", "-q", "-b", "main");
+writeFileSync(join(inner, "inside.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("untracked nested tree", nested, ["--tree-only"]);
+
+const hist = init("history");
+writeFileSync(join(hist, "gone.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "secp256k1")}\n`);
+commit(hist, "secret old");
+rmSync(join(hist, "gone.txt"));
+commit(hist, "safe head");
+const head = git(hist, "rev-parse", "HEAD");
+const graftPath = git(hist, "rev-parse", "--git-path", "info/grafts");
+writeFileSync(join(hist, graftPath), `${head}\n`);
+gateRun("grafts history", hist, ["--history-only"]);
+rmSync(join(hist, graftPath));
+
+const shallow = join(root, "shallow");
+git(root, "clone", "-q", "--depth", "1", `file://${hist}`, shallow);
+gateRun("shallow history", shallow, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const dupes = init("dupes");
+writeFileSync(join(dupes, "a.txt"), "same\n");
+writeFileSync(join(dupes, "b.txt"), "same\n");
+commit(dupes);
+gateRun("duplicate blobs rev", dupes, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);

+import { mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
+import { join } from "node:path";
+import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
+import { encodeSeed } from "ripple-address-codec";
+
+const root = process.argv[2];
+const gate = "$USER_TMP/T/x.ROpM8B/repo/tools/check-no-secrets.ts";
+const env = { ...process.env, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1", GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: "/dev/null", GIT_AUTHOR_NAME: "probe", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME: "probe", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid" };
+const sh = (cmd: string[], cwd = root) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(cmd, { cwd, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  if (r.exitCode !== 0) throw new Error(`${cmd.join(" ")} (${r.exitCode}): ${new TextDecoder().decode(r.stderr)}`);
+  return new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).trim();
+};
+const git = (repo: string, ...args: string[]) => sh(["git", "-C", repo, ...args]);
+const init = (name: string) => { const p = join(root, name); mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true }); git(p, "init", "-q", "-b", "main"); return p; };
+const commit = (repo: string, msg = "probe") => { git(repo, "add", "-A"); git(repo, "commit", "-q", "--no-gpg-sign", "-m", msg); };
+const gateRun = (name: string, repo: string, args: string[]) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(["bun", "run", gate, "--repo", repo, ...args, "--no-local-store"], { cwd: repo, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  const lines = new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).split("\n").filter((l) => /^(REFUSED:|FAILING:|scanned:|check-no-secrets:)/.test(l));
+  console.log(`${name}: process-exit=${r.exitCode}; ${lines.join(" | ")}`);
+};
+
+rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
+mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });
+
+const filterEq = init("filter-equals");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("filter= tree", filterEq, ["--tree-only"]);
+commit(filterEq);
+gateRun("filter= rev", filterEq, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const filterBare = init("filter-bare");
+git(filterBare, "config", "filter.set.clean", "sed 's/.*/SAFE/'");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter\n");
+const filteredSeed = encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, "payload.txt"), `${filteredSeed}\n`);
+console.log(`bare filter check-attr: ${git(filterBare, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+commit(filterBare);
+console.log(`bare filter committed payload: ${git(filterBare, "show", "HEAD:payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("bare filter rev", filterBare, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const attrComment = init("attr-comment");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, ".gitattributes"), "# Documentation example: *.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(attrComment);
+console.log(`comment check-attr: ${git(attrComment, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("comment-only attribute rev", attrComment, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const replace = init("replace");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519")}\n`);
+commit(replace);
+const original = git(replace, "rev-parse", "HEAD:f.txt");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const safe = git(replace, "hash-object", "-w", "f.txt");
+git(replace, "replace", original, safe);
+gateRun("replace rev", replace, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("replace history", replace, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const tab = init("tab");
+mkdirSync(join(tab, "a\tb"));
+writeFileSync(join(tab, "a\tb", "state.json"), "{}\n");
+commit(tab);
+gateRun("tab rev", tab, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("tab history", tab, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const child = init("child");
+writeFileSync(join(child, "child.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(child);
+const superRepo = init("ordinary-submodule");
+git(superRepo, "-c", "protocol.file.allow=always", "submodule", "add", "-q", child, "vendor/sub");
+commit(superRepo);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule tree", superRepo, ["--tree-only"]);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule rev", superRepo, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const nested = init("nested");
+writeFileSync(join(nested, "top.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const inner = join(nested, "inner");
+mkdirSync(inner);
+git(inner, "init", "-q", "-b", "main");
+writeFileSync(join(inner, "inside.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("untracked nested tree", nested, ["--tree-only"]);
+
+const hist = init("history");
+writeFileSync(join(hist, "gone.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "secp256k1")}\n`);
+commit(hist, "secret old");
+rmSync(join(hist, "gone.txt"));
+commit(hist, "safe head");
+const head = git(hist, "rev-parse", "HEAD");
+const graftPath = git(hist, "rev-parse", "--git-path", "info/grafts");
+writeFileSync(join(hist, graftPath), `${head}\n`);
+gateRun("grafts history", hist, ["--history-only"]);
+rmSync(join(hist, graftPath));
+
+const shallow = join(root, "shallow");
+git(root, "clone", "-q", "--depth", "1", `file://${hist}`, shallow);
+gateRun("shallow history", shallow, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const dupes = init("dupes");
+writeFileSync(join(dupes, "a.txt"), "same\n");
+writeFileSync(join(dupes, "b.txt"), "same\n");
+commit(dupes);
+gateRun("duplicate blobs rev", dupes, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);

+const result = (name: string, text: string) => {
+  const hits = scanText(text, empty);
+  console.log(`${name}: findings=${hits.filter((h) => !h.allowedBy).length} allowed=${hits.filter((h) => h.allowedBy).map((h) => h.allowedBy).join(" | ") || "none"}`);

+  console.log(`credential ${c.name}: failing=${hits.filter((h) => !h.allowedBy).length}`);
+}

+result("bob path", "[synthetic personal-path redacted]/client/ledger.txt\n");
+result("repeated-byte scalar", `production_private_key: ${"01".repeat(32)}\n`);
+result("toy scalar at bound minus one", `production_private_key: ${(2n ** 32n - 1n).toString(16).padStart(64, "0")}\n`);

+import { mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
+import { join } from "node:path";
+import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
+import { encodeSeed } from "ripple-address-codec";
+
+const root = process.argv[2];
+const gate = "$USER_TMP/T/x.ROpM8B/repo/tools/check-no-secrets.ts";
+const env = { ...process.env, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1", GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: "/dev/null", GIT_AUTHOR_NAME: "probe", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME: "probe", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid" };
+const sh = (cmd: string[], cwd = root) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(cmd, { cwd, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  if (r.exitCode !== 0) throw new Error(`${cmd.join(" ")} (${r.exitCode}): ${new TextDecoder().decode(r.stderr)}`);
+  return new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).trim();
+};
+const git = (repo: string, ...args: string[]) => sh(["git", "-C", repo, ...args]);
+const init = (name: string) => { const p = join(root, name); mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true }); git(p, "init", "-q", "-b", "main"); return p; };
+const commit = (repo: string, msg = "probe") => { git(repo, "add", "-A"); git(repo, "commit", "-q", "--no-gpg-sign", "-m", msg); };
+const gateRun = (name: string, repo: string, args: string[]) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(["bun", "run", gate, "--repo", repo, ...args, "--no-local-store"], { cwd: repo, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  const lines = new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).split("\n").filter((l) => /^(REFUSED:|FAILING:|scanned:|check-no-secrets:)/.test(l));
+  console.log(`${name}: process-exit=${r.exitCode}; ${lines.join(" | ")}`);
+};
+
+rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
+mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });
+
+const filterEq = init("filter-equals");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("filter= tree", filterEq, ["--tree-only"]);
+commit(filterEq);
+gateRun("filter= rev", filterEq, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const filterBare = init("filter-bare");
+git(filterBare, "config", "filter.set.clean", "sed 's/.*/SAFE/'");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter\n");
+const filteredSeed = encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, "payload.txt"), `${filteredSeed}\n`);
+console.log(`bare filter check-attr: ${git(filterBare, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+commit(filterBare);
+console.log(`bare filter committed payload: ${git(filterBare, "show", "HEAD:payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("bare filter rev", filterBare, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const attrComment = init("attr-comment");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, ".gitattributes"), "# Documentation example: *.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(attrComment);
+console.log(`comment check-attr: ${git(attrComment, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("comment-only attribute rev", attrComment, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const replace = init("replace");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519")}\n`);
+commit(replace);
+const original = git(replace, "rev-parse", "HEAD:f.txt");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const safe = git(replace, "hash-object", "-w", "f.txt");
+git(replace, "replace", original, safe);
+gateRun("replace rev", replace, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("replace history", replace, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const tab = init("tab");
+mkdirSync(join(tab, "a\tb"));
+writeFileSync(join(tab, "a\tb", "state.json"), "{}\n");
+commit(tab);
+gateRun("tab rev", tab, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("tab history", tab, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const child = init("child");
+writeFileSync(join(child, "child.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(child);
+const superRepo = init("ordinary-submodule");
+git(superRepo, "-c", "protocol.file.allow=always", "submodule", "add", "-q", child, "vendor/sub");
+commit(superRepo);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule tree", superRepo, ["--tree-only"]);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule rev", superRepo, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const nested = init("nested");
+writeFileSync(join(nested, "top.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const inner = join(nested, "inner");
+mkdirSync(inner);
+git(inner, "init", "-q", "-b", "main");
+writeFileSync(join(inner, "inside.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("untracked nested tree", nested, ["--tree-only"]);
+
+const hist = init("history");
+writeFileSync(join(hist, "gone.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "secp256k1")}\n`);
+commit(hist, "secret old");
+rmSync(join(hist, "gone.txt"));
+commit(hist, "safe head");
+const head = git(hist, "rev-parse", "HEAD");
+const graftPath = git(hist, "rev-parse", "--git-path", "info/grafts");
+writeFileSync(join(hist, graftPath), `${head}\n`);
+gateRun("grafts history", hist, ["--history-only"]);
+rmSync(join(hist, graftPath));

+commit(dupes);

+import { mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
+import { join } from "node:path";
+import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
+import { encodeSeed } from "ripple-address-codec";
+
+const root = process.argv[2];
+const gate = "$USER_TMP/T/x.ROpM8B/repo/tools/check-no-secrets.ts";
+const env = { ...process.env, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1", GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: "/dev/null", GIT_AUTHOR_NAME: "probe", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME: "probe", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid" };
+const sh = (cmd: string[], cwd = root) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(cmd, { cwd, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  if (r.exitCode !== 0) throw new Error(`${cmd.join(" ")} (${r.exitCode}): ${new TextDecoder().decode(r.stderr)}`);
+  return new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).trim();
+};
+const git = (repo: string, ...args: string[]) => sh(["git", "-C", repo, ...args]);
+const init = (name: string) => { const p = join(root, name); mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true }); git(p, "init", "-q", "-b", "main"); return p; };
+const commit = (repo: string, msg = "probe") => { git(repo, "add", "-A"); git(repo, "commit", "-q", "--no-gpg-sign", "-m", msg); };
+const gateRun = (name: string, repo: string, args: string[]) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(["bun", "run", gate, "--repo", repo, ...args, "--no-local-store"], { cwd: repo, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  const lines = new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).split("\n").filter((l) => /^(REFUSED:|FAILING:|scanned:|check-no-secrets:)/.test(l));
+  console.log(`${name}: process-exit=${r.exitCode}; ${lines.join(" | ")}`);
+};
+
+rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
+mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });
+
+const filterEq = init("filter-equals");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("filter= tree", filterEq, ["--tree-only"]);
+commit(filterEq);
+gateRun("filter= rev", filterEq, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const filterBare = init("filter-bare");
+git(filterBare, "config", "filter.set.clean", "sed 's/.*/SAFE/'");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter\n");
+const filteredSeed = encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, "payload.txt"), `${filteredSeed}\n`);
+console.log(`bare filter check-attr: ${git(filterBare, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+commit(filterBare);
+console.log(`bare filter committed payload: ${git(filterBare, "show", "HEAD:payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("bare filter rev", filterBare, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const attrComment = init("attr-comment");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, ".gitattributes"), "# Documentation example: *.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(attrComment);
+console.log(`comment check-attr: ${git(attrComment, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("comment-only attribute rev", attrComment, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const replace = init("replace");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519")}\n`);
+commit(replace);
+const original = git(replace, "rev-parse", "HEAD:f.txt");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const safe = git(replace, "hash-object", "-w", "f.txt");
+git(replace, "replace", original, safe);
+gateRun("replace rev", replace, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("replace history", replace, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const tab = init("tab");
+mkdirSync(join(tab, "a\tb"));
+writeFileSync(join(tab, "a\tb", "state.json"), "{}\n");
+commit(tab);
+gateRun("tab rev", tab, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("tab history", tab, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const child = init("child");
+writeFileSync(join(child, "child.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(child);
+const superRepo = init("ordinary-submodule");
+git(superRepo, "-c", "protocol.file.allow=always", "submodule", "add", "-q", child, "vendor/sub");
+commit(superRepo);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule tree", superRepo, ["--tree-only"]);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule rev", superRepo, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const nested = init("nested");
+writeFileSync(join(nested, "top.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const inner = join(nested, "inner");
+mkdirSync(inner);
+git(inner, "init", "-q", "-b", "main");
+writeFileSync(join(inner, "inside.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("untracked nested tree", nested, ["--tree-only"]);
+
+const hist = init("history");
+writeFileSync(join(hist, "gone.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "secp256k1")}\n`);
+commit(hist, "secret old");
+rmSync(join(hist, "gone.txt"));
+commit(hist, "safe head");
+const head = git(hist, "rev-parse", "HEAD");
+const graftPath = git(hist, "rev-parse", "--git-path", "info/grafts");
+writeFileSync(join(hist, graftPath), `${head}\n`);
+gateRun("grafts history", hist, ["--history-only"]);
+rmSync(join(hist, graftPath));
+
+const shallow = join(root, "shallow");
+git(root, "clone", "-q", "--depth", "1", `file://${hist}`, shallow);
+gateRun("shallow history", shallow, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const dupes = init("dupes");
+writeFileSync(join(dupes, "a.txt"), "same\n");
+writeFileSync(join(dupes, "b.txt"), "same\n");
+commit(dupes);
+gateRun("duplicate blobs rev", dupes, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);

+import { mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";

+const sh = (cmd: string[], cwd = root) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(cmd, { cwd, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  if (r.exitCode !== 0) throw new Error(`${cmd.join(" ")} (${r.exitCode}): ${new TextDecoder().decode(r.stderr)}`);

+const commit = (repo: string, msg = "probe") => { git(repo, "add", "-A"); git(repo, "commit", "-q", "--no-gpg-sign", "-m", msg); };

    41	## S4-1, the part not upheld
    42	
    43	The leg's argument is that the toy-scalar and repeated-byte allowances are
    44	context-free, so `production_private_key: 0x…fffffffffffffff1` and a repeated-byte
    45	seed labelled `production_seed` both pass.
    46	
    47	**Context does not change arithmetic.** Each rule admits only values anyone can
    48	recover from public information: a repeated-byte seed is one of 256, and its
    49	account can be swept by anyone who tries them. Publishing such a value adds
    50	nothing that was not already public, whatever the label says. That half is
    51	rejected, and the reason is now in the code.
    52	
    53	**The bound is upheld.** 2^64 was looser than the argument needs. A key in a 2^64
    54	interval falls to a kangaroo walk of about 2^32 steps, which is cheap but not
    55	free. At 2^32 "already public" holds without qualification, and the only labelled
    56	toy scalars in the tree are 7, 11, 13 and 17.
    57	
    58	## What the adjudication found that the leg did not
    59	
    60	- ⚠ **A flaky control was a real detector defect.** After the S1-1 fix, one run
    61	  in thirty failed `credential: Google API key`. The pattern ended in `\b`, and a
    62	  key may end in `-`, which leaves no word boundary before a newline. So about one
    63	  real key in 32 was invisible to the gate. The sample was right and the pattern
    64	  was wrong. Fixed with a negative lookahead; then 60 of 60 runs passed.
    65	- ⚠ **The S3-1 fix as first written produced false positives.** Taking any text
    66	  on the previous line as a label flagged four nonce test vectors in
    67	  `tools/spike-2026-08-18/t1-vectors.json`, listed in arrays named like
    68	  `"pok_sk, single nonce": [`. Narrowed: the previous line counts only when it
    69	  ends in `key:` or `key =`. An array of values under a label is now a printed
    70	  limit with an asserted-uncaught control, not a silent gap.
    71	- **The leg's own transcript failed the strengthened gate.** It planted
    72	  `[synthetic personal-path redacted]`, `aws_secret_access_key=AAAA…` and a toy key above 2^32. The
    73	  first two are now allowed by rule: `alice` and `bob` are the conventional
    74	  placeholder names, and a credential ending in sixteen copies of one character
    75	  is a placeholder. The toy key is a cited vector naming this round. All three
    76	  rules are printed in the gate's allowed list on every run.
    77	- **One scalar is now allowed by a rule rather than a citation.** `REVIEW-010a`
    78	  uses `sk_A = 0x0101…01` as a test input. A scalar of one repeated byte is
    79	  public for the same reason as the seed rule.

    31	`git ls-tree -r 04aa4f3` lists 620 paths, so the two counts agree.
    32	
    33	⚠ **This block was corrected after `REVIEW-056` round one (S5-3).** It used to
    34	quote a working-tree run as *"the final tree"*, reporting 613 files, and three
    35	files were committed after that run. The gate then counted unique blobs rather
    36	than paths, which made the miscount invisible. Both are fixed: the count is by
    37	path, and this block names the commit it was run on.
    38	
    39	## What it found
    40	
    41	- **No secret, anywhere.** None of the 19 local secrets appears in the tree or in
    42	  history, in any encoding the gate searches. No credential shape appears either.
    43	- **No secret-store file was ever committed.** No commit on any ref ever touched
    44	  a path named `state.json`, `facility-state.json`, `facility-book.json`,
    45	  `profile.json`, `.env` or a key file. With the line above, this verifies the
    46	  plan's claim two ways rather than assuming it. Neither the path nor any value
    47	  from `/tmp/wconf/state.json` ever entered git.
    48	- **Every seed in the tree is public by construction.** Eleven checksum-valid
    49	  seeds appear, and the gate decoded each one. Each has entropy from a published
    50	  rule: one byte repeated, the bytes `0x00` to `0x0f`, or rippled's genesis
    51	  passphrase.
    52	- **Personal paths in 42 tracked files**: the home directory, the macOS
    53	  per-user temp root, and the repository's dash-encoded scratchpad name. 40 of
    54	  them are review transcripts and outputs, mostly Codex and Gemini legs that
    55	  printed their working directory. One is the F-12 evidence README. One was code,
    56	  a spike with the repository root hardcoded.
    57	- **Third-party email addresses in 4 review files**, one of which had no path.
    58	  They came from `git log` output and crate metadata that legs printed. None is
    59	  material to a finding.
    60	
    61	## What was changed
    62	
    63	1. **The spike was fixed, not scrubbed**: it now computes its root
    64	   (commit `2667870`). A redacted path in code no longer runs.
    65	2. **42 files were scrubbed**, 41 under `docs/reviews/` and the F-12 README, by
    66	   `tools/scrub-personal-data.ts`, which derives
    67	   every substitution from the machine and finds emails with the gate's own
    68	   detector. `scrub-tracked-files.md` is its output, with per-file counts and no
    69	   values. Every changed file kept its line count. A word diff of the result
    70	   showed that every added token carries a placeholder.

    73	   |---|---|
    74	   | `$REPO` | the repository root |

    76	   | `$HOME` | the home directory |
    77	   | `$USER_TMP` | the macOS per-user temp root |
    78	   | `redacted@example.invalid` | a third-party email address |

    81	   them as home-path hits the sweep should expect. The count was right and the
    82	   premise was not: **no log was in the publication tree**, because `*.log` is
    83	   gitignored and only the README was ever committed. So the README beside them
    84	   cited 57 log files that a reader of the repository could not open. All 57 are now committed under one `.gitignore` negation for that
    85	   directory alone. 46 changed in the scrub: 42 carried the home directory and
    86	   more carried the per-user temp root. `scrub-emsdk-logs.md` is the table.

    89	
    90	- **Three recorded hashes no longer reproduce from the scrubbed text.**
    91	  `logs/06-runner-scripts.log` lists five runner scripts with their sha256.
    92	  Re-hashing each listing from the original log reproduces all five. From the
    93	  scrubbed log, `install-emsdk.sh` and `run-group.sh` still reproduce, and
    94	  `run-build.sh`, `run-test.sh` and `run-xtrace.sh` do not. Each of those three
    95	  had the home directory on its `NODE22=` line. The F-12 README says so where it
    96	  prints the scripts.
    97	- **No other recorded hash is affected.** The undefined-symbol set hashes in
    98	  `logs/08-gen-tables-and-symbol-sets.log` are over symbol names; that log's
    99	  only two changed lines are the paths in a `shasum` listing. The build-output
   100	  hashes are over binary outputs, and only the paths beside them changed.
   101	- **The originals are kept, locally, unpublished**, at
   102	  `docs/evidence/f12-emsdk-2026-10-18/logs-unscrubbed/`, which stays ignored. If
   103	  a negation or a `git add -f` ever brought them into the tree, the gate would fail
   104	  on them. `emsdk-logs-unscrubbed.sha256` and `emsdk-logs-scrubbed.sha256` record
   105	  both sides.
   106	
   107	## A decision this took, and why it is reversible
   108	
   109	`docs/reviews/` is a historical record, and the launch plan publishes it. 41
   110	review files had personal paths or emails redacted. **That changes the bytes of a
   111	record and not what any leg was shown to mean**: a path under the home directory is
   112	still a path under the home directory. The private archive keeps every original in
   113	history, which is not rewritten. The squash ruling (`CLAIMS.md` E-309) means history
   114	is not published. Vocabulary in `docs/reviews/` is untouched. Whether the
   115	`tapFailHard` translation reaches those files is still the owner's decision.
   116	
   117	## What this does not establish
   118	
   119	- **Personal data is still in history.** The gate reports 1,045 path hits and 30
   120	  email hits in old blobs, and does not fail on them, because history is squashed
   121	  at publication. If anyone proposes publishing the history,
   122	  `bun run tools/check-no-secrets.ts --strict-history` fails on them, and history
   123	  would need rewriting first.
   124	- **The gate is lexical, over named classes.** `check-no-secrets` prints what it
   125	  cannot see on every run. That covers a secret split across literals, any
   126	  re-encoding, an unlabelled scalar that is not in the local store, and hostnames
   127	  and names. Each limit is an asserted-uncaught control, so the list cannot go
   128	  stale silently.
   129	- **The publication commit has not been scanned, because it does not exist yet.**
   130	  Phase 1 item 5 creates it, and the gate's `--repo <clone> --rev <commit>` form
   131	  runs on exactly that tree. That run is the phase 1 gate, and this one is not.
   132	- **The gate has had one external review round, and its fixes have not been
   133	  reviewed.** `REVIEW-056` round one found 13 defects, of which 12 were upheld
   134	  and 1 upheld in part, all fixed in `04aa4f3` (`REVIEW-056c`). Round two, on
   135	  those fixes, is owed under `CLAUDE.md`'s two-round rule.

+import { mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
+import { join } from "node:path";
+import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
+import { encodeSeed } from "ripple-address-codec";
+
+const root = process.argv[2];
+const gate = "$USER_TMP/T/x.ROpM8B/repo/tools/check-no-secrets.ts";
+const env = { ...process.env, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1", GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: "/dev/null", GIT_AUTHOR_NAME: "probe", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME: "probe", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid" };
+const sh = (cmd: string[], cwd = root) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(cmd, { cwd, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  if (r.exitCode !== 0) throw new Error(`${cmd.join(" ")} (${r.exitCode}): ${new TextDecoder().decode(r.stderr)}`);
+  return new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).trim();
+};
+const git = (repo: string, ...args: string[]) => sh(["git", "-C", repo, ...args]);
+const init = (name: string) => { const p = join(root, name); mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true }); git(p, "init", "-q", "-b", "main"); return p; };
+const commit = (repo: string, msg = "probe") => { git(repo, "add", "-A"); git(repo, "commit", "-q", "--no-gpg-sign", "-m", msg); };
+const gateRun = (name: string, repo: string, args: string[]) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(["bun", "run", gate, "--repo", repo, ...args, "--no-local-store"], { cwd: repo, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  const lines = new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).split("\n").filter((l) => /^(REFUSED:|FAILING:|scanned:|check-no-secrets:)/.test(l));
+  console.log(`${name}: process-exit=${r.exitCode}; ${lines.join(" | ")}`);
+};
+
+rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
+mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });
+
+const filterEq = init("filter-equals");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("filter= tree", filterEq, ["--tree-only"]);
+commit(filterEq);
+gateRun("filter= rev", filterEq, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const filterBare = init("filter-bare");
+git(filterBare, "config", "filter.set.clean", "sed 's/.*/SAFE/'");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter\n");
+const filteredSeed = encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, "payload.txt"), `${filteredSeed}\n`);
+console.log(`bare filter check-attr: ${git(filterBare, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+commit(filterBare);
+console.log(`bare filter committed payload: ${git(filterBare, "show", "HEAD:payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("bare filter rev", filterBare, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const attrComment = init("attr-comment");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, ".gitattributes"), "# Documentation example: *.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(attrComment);
+console.log(`comment check-attr: ${git(attrComment, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("comment-only attribute rev", attrComment, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const replace = init("replace");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519")}\n`);
+commit(replace);
+const original = git(replace, "rev-parse", "HEAD:f.txt");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const safe = git(replace, "hash-object", "-w", "f.txt");
+git(replace, "replace", original, safe);
+gateRun("replace rev", replace, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("replace history", replace, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const tab = init("tab");
+mkdirSync(join(tab, "a\tb"));
+writeFileSync(join(tab, "a\tb", "state.json"), "{}\n");
+commit(tab);
+gateRun("tab rev", tab, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("tab history", tab, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const child = init("child");
+writeFileSync(join(child, "child.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(child);
+const superRepo = init("ordinary-submodule");
+git(superRepo, "-c", "protocol.file.allow=always", "submodule", "add", "-q", child, "vendor/sub");
+commit(superRepo);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule tree", superRepo, ["--tree-only"]);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule rev", superRepo, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+

+import { mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
+import { join } from "node:path";
+import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
+import { encodeSeed } from "ripple-address-codec";
+
+const root = process.argv[2];
+const gate = "$USER_TMP/T/x.ROpM8B/repo/tools/check-no-secrets.ts";
+const env = { ...process.env, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1", GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: "/dev/null", GIT_AUTHOR_NAME: "probe", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME: "probe", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid" };
+const sh = (cmd: string[], cwd = root) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(cmd, { cwd, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  if (r.exitCode !== 0) throw new Error(`${cmd.join(" ")} (${r.exitCode}): ${new TextDecoder().decode(r.stderr)}`);
+  return new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).trim();
+};
+const git = (repo: string, ...args: string[]) => sh(["git", "-C", repo, ...args]);
+const init = (name: string) => { const p = join(root, name); mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true }); git(p, "init", "-q", "-b", "main"); return p; };
+const commit = (repo: string, msg = "probe") => { git(repo, "add", "-A"); git(repo, "commit", "-q", "--no-gpg-sign", "-m", msg); };
+const gateRun = (name: string, repo: string, args: string[]) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(["bun", "run", gate, "--repo", repo, ...args, "--no-local-store"], { cwd: repo, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  const lines = new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).split("\n").filter((l) => /^(REFUSED:|FAILING:|scanned:|check-no-secrets:)/.test(l));
+  console.log(`${name}: process-exit=${r.exitCode}; ${lines.join(" | ")}`);
+};
+
+rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
+mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });
+
+const filterEq = init("filter-equals");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("filter= tree", filterEq, ["--tree-only"]);
+commit(filterEq);
+gateRun("filter= rev", filterEq, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const filterBare = init("filter-bare");
+git(filterBare, "config", "filter.set.clean", "sed 's/.*/SAFE/'");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter\n");
+const filteredSeed = encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, "payload.txt"), `${filteredSeed}\n`);
+console.log(`bare filter check-attr: ${git(filterBare, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+commit(filterBare);
+console.log(`bare filter committed payload: ${git(filterBare, "show", "HEAD:payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("bare filter rev", filterBare, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const attrComment = init("attr-comment");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, ".gitattributes"), "# Documentation example: *.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(attrComment);
+console.log(`comment check-attr: ${git(attrComment, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("comment-only attribute rev", attrComment, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const replace = init("replace");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519")}\n`);
+commit(replace);
+const original = git(replace, "rev-parse", "HEAD:f.txt");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), "SAFE\n");

+git(replace, "replace", original, safe);

+gateRun("tab rev", tab, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("tab history", tab, ["--history-only"]);
+

+writeFileSync(join(child, "child.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(child);
+const superRepo = init("ordinary-submodule");
+git(superRepo, "-c", "protocol.file.allow=always", "submodule", "add", "-q", child, "vendor/sub");
+commit(superRepo);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule tree", superRepo, ["--tree-only"]);

+import { mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";

+const sh = (cmd: string[], cwd = root) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(cmd, { cwd, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });

+};

+  const hits = scanText(text, empty);
+  console.log(`${name}: findings=${hits.filter((h) => !h.allowedBy).length} allowed=${hits.filter((h) => h.allowedBy).map((h) => h.allowedBy).join(" | ") || "none"}`);

+result("bob path", "[synthetic personal-path redacted]/client/ledger.txt\n");
+result("repeated-byte scalar", `production_private_key: ${"01".repeat(32)}\n`);
+result("toy scalar at bound minus one", `production_private_key: ${(2n ** 32n - 1n).toString(16).padStart(64, "0")}\n`);

+import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
+import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
+import { join } from "node:path";
+import { encodeSeed } from "ripple-address-codec";
+import {
+  CREDENTIALS, CITED_VECTORS, credentialHits, loadStore, pathHits, scanText,
+  type Store,
+} from "$USER_TMP/T/x.ROpM8B/repo/tools/check-no-secrets.ts";
+
+const empty: Store = { files: [], needles: [], secrets: 0, publicSkipped: 0 };
+const result = (name: string, text: string) => {
+  const hits = scanText(text, empty);
+  console.log(`${name}: findings=${hits.filter((h) => !h.allowedBy).length} allowed=${hits.filter((h) => h.allowedBy).map((h) => h.allowedBy).join(" | ") || "none"}`);
+};
+
+for (const c of CREDENTIALS) {
+  const hits = credentialHits(c.sample());
+  console.log(`credential ${c.name}: failing=${hits.filter((h) => !h.allowedBy).length}`);
+}
+
+const scalar64 = "12" + "34".repeat(31);
+const scalar63 = scalar64.slice(1);
+const scalar57 = "123456789abcdef".repeat(3) + "123456789abc";
+result("round1 pretty-json", `{"private_key":\n "${scalar64}"}\n`);
+result("round1 table", `| ${scalar64} | private key |\n`);
+result("round1 unpadded-63", `private_key: ${scalar63}\n`);
+result("blank-line pretty-json", `{"private_key":\n\n "${scalar64}"}\n`);
+result("unpadded-57", `private_key: ${scalar57}\n`);
+result("round1 aws-secret", `aws_secret_access_key=${"Ab0/".repeat(10)}\n`);
+result("AWS JSON SecretAccessKey", `{"SecretAccessKey":"${"Ab0/".repeat(10)}"}\n`);
+result("AWS hyphenated label", `aws-secret-access-key=${"Ab0/".repeat(10)}\n`);
+result("placeholder-shaped credential", `xoxb-${"Ab3-".repeat(6)}${"-".repeat(16)}\n`);
+result("alice path", "[synthetic personal-path redacted]/private-client/plan.md\n");
+result("bob path", "[synthetic personal-path redacted]/client/ledger.txt\n");
+result("repeated-byte scalar", `production_private_key: ${"01".repeat(32)}\n`);
+result("toy scalar at bound minus one", `production_private_key: ${(2n ** 32n - 1n).toString(16).padStart(64, "0")}\n`);
+result("cited round-one fixture", `production_private_key: ${CITED_VECTORS.at(-1)!.value}\n`);
+
+const publicSeed = encodeSeed(Buffer.alloc(16, 1), "secp256k1");
+result("repeated-byte seed", `production_seed: ${publicSeed}\n`);
+
+const storeDir = process.argv[2];
+mkdirSync(storeDir, { recursive: true });
+const storedScalar = randomBytes(32).toString("hex");
+writeFileSync(join(storeDir, "good.json"), JSON.stringify({ seed: encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519") }));
+writeFileSync(join(storeDir, "broken.json"), `{"sk":"${storedScalar}"`);
+try {
+  loadStore([storeDir], {});

+  console.log(`malformed store: REFUSED=${String(e).includes("not valid JSON")}`);

+import { mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";

+const sh = (cmd: string[], cwd = root) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(cmd, { cwd, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  if (r.exitCode !== 0) throw new Error(`${cmd.join(" ")} (${r.exitCode}): ${new TextDecoder().decode(r.stderr)}`);
+  return new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).trim();

+const commit = (repo: string, msg = "probe") => { git(repo, "add", "-A"); git(repo, "commit", "-q", "--no-gpg-sign", "-m", msg); };

+  const lines = new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).split("\n").filter((l) => /^(REFUSED:|FAILING:|scanned:|check-no-secrets:)/.test(l));
+  console.log(`${name}: process-exit=${r.exitCode}; ${lines.join(" | ")}`);
+};

+
+const empty: Store = { files: [], needles: [], secrets: 0, publicSkipped: 0 };
+const result = (name: string, text: string) => {
+  const hits = scanText(text, empty);
+  console.log(`${name}: findings=${hits.filter((h) => !h.allowedBy).length} allowed=${hits.filter((h) => h.allowedBy).map((h) => h.allowedBy).join(" | ") || "none"}`);

+
+for (const c of CREDENTIALS) {

+result("toy scalar at bound minus one", `production_private_key: ${(2n ** 32n - 1n).toString(16).padStart(64, "0")}\n`);

+import { mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
+import { join } from "node:path";
+import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
+import { encodeSeed } from "ripple-address-codec";
+
+const root = process.argv[2];
+const gate = "$USER_TMP/T/x.ROpM8B/repo/tools/check-no-secrets.ts";
+const env = { ...process.env, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1", GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: "/dev/null", GIT_AUTHOR_NAME: "probe", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME: "probe", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid" };
+const sh = (cmd: string[], cwd = root) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(cmd, { cwd, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  if (r.exitCode !== 0) throw new Error(`${cmd.join(" ")} (${r.exitCode}): ${new TextDecoder().decode(r.stderr)}`);
+  return new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).trim();
+};
+const git = (repo: string, ...args: string[]) => sh(["git", "-C", repo, ...args]);
+const init = (name: string) => { const p = join(root, name); mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true }); git(p, "init", "-q", "-b", "main"); return p; };
+const commit = (repo: string, msg = "probe") => { git(repo, "add", "-A"); git(repo, "commit", "-q", "--no-gpg-sign", "-m", msg); };
+const gateRun = (name: string, repo: string, args: string[]) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(["bun", "run", gate, "--repo", repo, ...args, "--no-local-store"], { cwd: repo, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  const lines = new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).split("\n").filter((l) => /^(REFUSED:|FAILING:|scanned:|check-no-secrets:)/.test(l));
+  console.log(`${name}: process-exit=${r.exitCode}; ${lines.join(" | ")}`);
+};
+
+rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
+mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });
+
+const filterEq = init("filter-equals");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("filter= tree", filterEq, ["--tree-only"]);
+commit(filterEq);
+gateRun("filter= rev", filterEq, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const filterBare = init("filter-bare");
+git(filterBare, "config", "filter.set.clean", "sed 's/.*/SAFE/'");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter\n");
+const filteredSeed = encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, "payload.txt"), `${filteredSeed}\n`);
+console.log(`bare filter check-attr: ${git(filterBare, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+commit(filterBare);
+console.log(`bare filter committed payload: ${git(filterBare, "show", "HEAD:payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("bare filter rev", filterBare, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const attrComment = init("attr-comment");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, ".gitattributes"), "# Documentation example: *.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(attrComment);
+console.log(`comment check-attr: ${git(attrComment, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("comment-only attribute rev", attrComment, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const replace = init("replace");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519")}\n`);
+commit(replace);
+const original = git(replace, "rev-parse", "HEAD:f.txt");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const safe = git(replace, "hash-object", "-w", "f.txt");
+git(replace, "replace", original, safe);
+gateRun("replace rev", replace, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("replace history", replace, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const tab = init("tab");
+mkdirSync(join(tab, "a\tb"));
+writeFileSync(join(tab, "a\tb", "state.json"), "{}\n");
+commit(tab);
+gateRun("tab rev", tab, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("tab history", tab, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const child = init("child");
+writeFileSync(join(child, "child.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(child);
+const superRepo = init("ordinary-submodule");
+git(superRepo, "-c", "protocol.file.allow=always", "submodule", "add", "-q", child, "vendor/sub");
+commit(superRepo);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule tree", superRepo, ["--tree-only"]);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule rev", superRepo, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const nested = init("nested");
+writeFileSync(join(nested, "top.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const inner = join(nested, "inner");
+mkdirSync(inner);
+git(inner, "init", "-q", "-b", "main");
+writeFileSync(join(inner, "inside.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("untracked nested tree", nested, ["--tree-only"]);
+
+const hist = init("history");
+writeFileSync(join(hist, "gone.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "secp256k1")}\n`);
+commit(hist, "secret old");
+rmSync(join(hist, "gone.txt"));
+commit(hist, "safe head");
+const head = git(hist, "rev-parse", "HEAD");
+const graftPath = git(hist, "rev-parse", "--git-path", "info/grafts");
+writeFileSync(join(hist, graftPath), `${head}\n`);
+gateRun("grafts history", hist, ["--history-only"]);
+rmSync(join(hist, graftPath));
+
+const shallow = join(root, "shallow");
+git(root, "clone", "-q", "--depth", "1", `file://${hist}`, shallow);
+gateRun("shallow history", shallow, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const dupes = init("dupes");
+writeFileSync(join(dupes, "a.txt"), "same\n");
+writeFileSync(join(dupes, "b.txt"), "same\n");
+commit(dupes);
+gateRun("duplicate blobs rev", dupes, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);

+import { mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
+import { join } from "node:path";
+import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
+import { encodeSeed } from "ripple-address-codec";

+const sh = (cmd: string[], cwd = root) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(cmd, { cwd, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  if (r.exitCode !== 0) throw new Error(`${cmd.join(" ")} (${r.exitCode}): ${new TextDecoder().decode(r.stderr)}`);
+  return new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).trim();
+};
+const git = (repo: string, ...args: string[]) => sh(["git", "-C", repo, ...args]);
+const init = (name: string) => { const p = join(root, name); mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true }); git(p, "init", "-q", "-b", "main"); return p; };
+const commit = (repo: string, msg = "probe") => { git(repo, "add", "-A"); git(repo, "commit", "-q", "--no-gpg-sign", "-m", msg); };
+const gateRun = (name: string, repo: string, args: string[]) => {

+  const lines = new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).split("\n").filter((l) => /^(REFUSED:|FAILING:|scanned:|check-no-secrets:)/.test(l));
+  console.log(`${name}: process-exit=${r.exitCode}; ${lines.join(" | ")}`);
+};

+rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
+mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });
+

+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("filter= tree", filterEq, ["--tree-only"]);
+commit(filterEq);
+gateRun("filter= rev", filterEq, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);

+const filterBare = init("filter-bare");
+git(filterBare, "config", "filter.set.clean", "sed 's/.*/SAFE/'");

+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, "payload.txt"), `${filteredSeed}\n`);

+commit(filterBare);
+console.log(`bare filter committed payload: ${git(filterBare, "show", "HEAD:payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("bare filter rev", filterBare, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);

+commit(superRepo);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule tree", superRepo, ["--tree-only"]);

+writeFileSync(join(inner, "inside.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("untracked nested tree", nested, ["--tree-only"]);

+import { mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
+import { join } from "node:path";
+import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
+import { encodeSeed } from "ripple-address-codec";
+
+const root = process.argv[2];
+const gate = "$USER_TMP/T/x.ROpM8B/repo/tools/check-no-secrets.ts";
+const env = { ...process.env, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1", GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: "/dev/null", GIT_AUTHOR_NAME: "probe", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME: "probe", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid" };
+const sh = (cmd: string[], cwd = root) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(cmd, { cwd, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  if (r.exitCode !== 0) throw new Error(`${cmd.join(" ")} (${r.exitCode}): ${new TextDecoder().decode(r.stderr)}`);
+  return new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).trim();
+};
+const git = (repo: string, ...args: string[]) => sh(["git", "-C", repo, ...args]);
+const init = (name: string) => { const p = join(root, name); mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true }); git(p, "init", "-q", "-b", "main"); return p; };
+const commit = (repo: string, msg = "probe") => { git(repo, "add", "-A"); git(repo, "commit", "-q", "--no-gpg-sign", "-m", msg); };
+const gateRun = (name: string, repo: string, args: string[]) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(["bun", "run", gate, "--repo", repo, ...args, "--no-local-store"], { cwd: repo, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  const lines = new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).split("\n").filter((l) => /^(REFUSED:|FAILING:|scanned:|check-no-secrets:)/.test(l));
+  console.log(`${name}: process-exit=${r.exitCode}; ${lines.join(" | ")}`);
+};
+
+rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
+mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });
+
+const filterEq = init("filter-equals");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("filter= tree", filterEq, ["--tree-only"]);
+commit(filterEq);
+gateRun("filter= rev", filterEq, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const filterBare = init("filter-bare");
+git(filterBare, "config", "filter.set.clean", "sed 's/.*/SAFE/'");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter\n");
+const filteredSeed = encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, "payload.txt"), `${filteredSeed}\n`);
+console.log(`bare filter check-attr: ${git(filterBare, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+commit(filterBare);
+console.log(`bare filter committed payload: ${git(filterBare, "show", "HEAD:payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("bare filter rev", filterBare, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const attrComment = init("attr-comment");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, ".gitattributes"), "# Documentation example: *.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(attrComment);
+console.log(`comment check-attr: ${git(attrComment, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("comment-only attribute rev", attrComment, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const replace = init("replace");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519")}\n`);
+commit(replace);
+const original = git(replace, "rev-parse", "HEAD:f.txt");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const safe = git(replace, "hash-object", "-w", "f.txt");
+git(replace, "replace", original, safe);
+gateRun("replace rev", replace, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("replace history", replace, ["--history-only"]);

+mkdirSync(join(tab, "a\tb"));
+writeFileSync(join(tab, "a\tb", "state.json"), "{}\n");
+commit(tab);
+gateRun("tab rev", tab, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("tab history", tab, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const child = init("child");
+writeFileSync(join(child, "child.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(child);
+const superRepo = init("ordinary-submodule");
+git(superRepo, "-c", "protocol.file.allow=always", "submodule", "add", "-q", child, "vendor/sub");
+commit(superRepo);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule tree", superRepo, ["--tree-only"]);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule rev", superRepo, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const nested = init("nested");
+writeFileSync(join(nested, "top.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const inner = join(nested, "inner");
+mkdirSync(inner);
+git(inner, "init", "-q", "-b", "main");
+writeFileSync(join(inner, "inside.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("untracked nested tree", nested, ["--tree-only"]);
+
+const hist = init("history");
+writeFileSync(join(hist, "gone.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "secp256k1")}\n`);
+commit(hist, "secret old");
+rmSync(join(hist, "gone.txt"));
+commit(hist, "safe head");
+const head = git(hist, "rev-parse", "HEAD");
+const graftPath = git(hist, "rev-parse", "--git-path", "info/grafts");
+writeFileSync(join(hist, graftPath), `${head}\n`);
+gateRun("grafts history", hist, ["--history-only"]);
+rmSync(join(hist, graftPath));
+
+const shallow = join(root, "shallow");
+git(root, "clone", "-q", "--depth", "1", `file://${hist}`, shallow);
+gateRun("shallow history", shallow, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const dupes = init("dupes");
+writeFileSync(join(dupes, "a.txt"), "same\n");
+writeFileSync(join(dupes, "b.txt"), "same\n");
+commit(dupes);
+gateRun("duplicate blobs rev", dupes, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);

+import { mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
+import { join } from "node:path";
+import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
+import { encodeSeed } from "ripple-address-codec";
+
+const root = process.argv[2];
+const gate = "$USER_TMP/T/x.ROpM8B/repo/tools/check-no-secrets.ts";
+const env = { ...process.env, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1", GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: "/dev/null", GIT_AUTHOR_NAME: "probe", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME: "probe", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid" };
+const sh = (cmd: string[], cwd = root) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(cmd, { cwd, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  if (r.exitCode !== 0) throw new Error(`${cmd.join(" ")} (${r.exitCode}): ${new TextDecoder().decode(r.stderr)}`);
+  return new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).trim();
+};
+const git = (repo: string, ...args: string[]) => sh(["git", "-C", repo, ...args]);
+const init = (name: string) => { const p = join(root, name); mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true }); git(p, "init", "-q", "-b", "main"); return p; };
+const commit = (repo: string, msg = "probe") => { git(repo, "add", "-A"); git(repo, "commit", "-q", "--no-gpg-sign", "-m", msg); };
+const gateRun = (name: string, repo: string, args: string[]) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(["bun", "run", gate, "--repo", repo, ...args, "--no-local-store"], { cwd: repo, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  const lines = new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).split("\n").filter((l) => /^(REFUSED:|FAILING:|scanned:|check-no-secrets:)/.test(l));
+  console.log(`${name}: process-exit=${r.exitCode}; ${lines.join(" | ")}`);
+};
+
+rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
+mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });
+
+const filterEq = init("filter-equals");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("filter= tree", filterEq, ["--tree-only"]);
+commit(filterEq);
+gateRun("filter= rev", filterEq, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const filterBare = init("filter-bare");
+git(filterBare, "config", "filter.set.clean", "sed 's/.*/SAFE/'");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter\n");
+const filteredSeed = encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, "payload.txt"), `${filteredSeed}\n`);
+console.log(`bare filter check-attr: ${git(filterBare, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+commit(filterBare);
+console.log(`bare filter committed payload: ${git(filterBare, "show", "HEAD:payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("bare filter rev", filterBare, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const attrComment = init("attr-comment");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, ".gitattributes"), "# Documentation example: *.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(attrComment);
+console.log(`comment check-attr: ${git(attrComment, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("comment-only attribute rev", attrComment, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const replace = init("replace");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519")}\n`);
+commit(replace);
+const original = git(replace, "rev-parse", "HEAD:f.txt");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const safe = git(replace, "hash-object", "-w", "f.txt");
+git(replace, "replace", original, safe);
+gateRun("replace rev", replace, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("replace history", replace, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const tab = init("tab");
+mkdirSync(join(tab, "a\tb"));
+writeFileSync(join(tab, "a\tb", "state.json"), "{}\n");
+commit(tab);
+gateRun("tab rev", tab, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("tab history", tab, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const child = init("child");
+writeFileSync(join(child, "child.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(child);
+const superRepo = init("ordinary-submodule");
+git(superRepo, "-c", "protocol.file.allow=always", "submodule", "add", "-q", child, "vendor/sub");
+commit(superRepo);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule tree", superRepo, ["--tree-only"]);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule rev", superRepo, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const nested = init("nested");
+writeFileSync(join(nested, "top.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const inner = join(nested, "inner");
+mkdirSync(inner);
+git(inner, "init", "-q", "-b", "main");
+writeFileSync(join(inner, "inside.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("untracked nested tree", nested, ["--tree-only"]);
+
+const hist = init("history");
+writeFileSync(join(hist, "gone.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "secp256k1")}\n`);
+commit(hist, "secret old");
+rmSync(join(hist, "gone.txt"));
+commit(hist, "safe head");
+const head = git(hist, "rev-parse", "HEAD");
+const graftPath = git(hist, "rev-parse", "--git-path", "info/grafts");
+writeFileSync(join(hist, graftPath), `${head}\n`);
+gateRun("grafts history", hist, ["--history-only"]);
+rmSync(join(hist, graftPath));
+
+const shallow = join(root, "shallow");
+git(root, "clone", "-q", "--depth", "1", `file://${hist}`, shallow);
+gateRun("shallow history", shallow, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const dupes = init("dupes");
+writeFileSync(join(dupes, "a.txt"), "same\n");
+writeFileSync(join(dupes, "b.txt"), "same\n");
+commit(dupes);
+gateRun("duplicate blobs rev", dupes, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);

+import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
+import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
+import { join } from "node:path";
+import { encodeSeed } from "ripple-address-codec";
+import {

+  type Store,
+} from "$USER_TMP/T/x.ROpM8B/repo/tools/check-no-secrets.ts";
+
+const empty: Store = { files: [], needles: [], secrets: 0, publicSkipped: 0 };
+const result = (name: string, text: string) => {
+  const hits = scanText(text, empty);
+  console.log(`${name}: findings=${hits.filter((h) => !h.allowedBy).length} allowed=${hits.filter((h) => h.allowedBy).map((h) => h.allowedBy).join(" | ") || "none"}`);
+};
+
+for (const c of CREDENTIALS) {
+  const hits = credentialHits(c.sample());
+  console.log(`credential ${c.name}: failing=${hits.filter((h) => !h.allowedBy).length}`);
+}
+
+const scalar64 = "12" + "34".repeat(31);
+const scalar63 = scalar64.slice(1);
+const scalar57 = "123456789abcdef".repeat(3) + "123456789abc";

+result("round1 table", `| ${scalar64} | private key |\n`);
+result("round1 unpadded-63", `private_key: ${scalar63}\n`);
+result("blank-line pretty-json", `{"private_key":\n\n "${scalar64}"}\n`);
+result("unpadded-57", `private_key: ${scalar57}\n`);

+result("AWS JSON SecretAccessKey", `{"SecretAccessKey":"${"Ab0/".repeat(10)}"}\n`);

+result("placeholder-shaped credential", `xoxb-${"Ab3-".repeat(6)}${"-".repeat(16)}\n`);
+result("alice path", "[synthetic personal-path redacted]/private-client/plan.md\n");
+result("bob path", "[synthetic personal-path redacted]/client/ledger.txt\n");
+result("repeated-byte scalar", `production_private_key: ${"01".repeat(32)}\n`);
+result("toy scalar at bound minus one", `production_private_key: ${(2n ** 32n - 1n).toString(16).padStart(64, "0")}\n`);
+result("cited round-one fixture", `production_private_key: ${CITED_VECTORS.at(-1)!.value}\n`);

+result("repeated-byte seed", `production_seed: ${publicSeed}\n`);

+import { mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
+import { join } from "node:path";
+import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
+import { encodeSeed } from "ripple-address-codec";
+
+const root = process.argv[2];
+const gate = "$USER_TMP/T/x.ROpM8B/repo/tools/check-no-secrets.ts";
+const env = { ...process.env, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1", GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: "/dev/null", GIT_AUTHOR_NAME: "probe", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME: "probe", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid" };
+const sh = (cmd: string[], cwd = root) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(cmd, { cwd, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  if (r.exitCode !== 0) throw new Error(`${cmd.join(" ")} (${r.exitCode}): ${new TextDecoder().decode(r.stderr)}`);
+  return new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).trim();
+};
+const git = (repo: string, ...args: string[]) => sh(["git", "-C", repo, ...args]);
+const init = (name: string) => { const p = join(root, name); mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true }); git(p, "init", "-q", "-b", "main"); return p; };
+const commit = (repo: string, msg = "probe") => { git(repo, "add", "-A"); git(repo, "commit", "-q", "--no-gpg-sign", "-m", msg); };
+const gateRun = (name: string, repo: string, args: string[]) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(["bun", "run", gate, "--repo", repo, ...args, "--no-local-store"], { cwd: repo, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  const lines = new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).split("\n").filter((l) => /^(REFUSED:|FAILING:|scanned:|check-no-secrets:)/.test(l));
+  console.log(`${name}: process-exit=${r.exitCode}; ${lines.join(" | ")}`);
+};
+
+rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
+mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });
+
+const filterEq = init("filter-equals");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("filter= tree", filterEq, ["--tree-only"]);
+commit(filterEq);
+gateRun("filter= rev", filterEq, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const filterBare = init("filter-bare");
+git(filterBare, "config", "filter.set.clean", "sed 's/.*/SAFE/'");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter\n");
+const filteredSeed = encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, "payload.txt"), `${filteredSeed}\n`);
+console.log(`bare filter check-attr: ${git(filterBare, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+commit(filterBare);
+console.log(`bare filter committed payload: ${git(filterBare, "show", "HEAD:payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("bare filter rev", filterBare, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const attrComment = init("attr-comment");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, ".gitattributes"), "# Documentation example: *.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(attrComment);
+console.log(`comment check-attr: ${git(attrComment, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("comment-only attribute rev", attrComment, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const replace = init("replace");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519")}\n`);
+commit(replace);
+const original = git(replace, "rev-parse", "HEAD:f.txt");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const safe = git(replace, "hash-object", "-w", "f.txt");
+git(replace, "replace", original, safe);
+gateRun("replace rev", replace, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("replace history", replace, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const tab = init("tab");
+mkdirSync(join(tab, "a\tb"));
+writeFileSync(join(tab, "a\tb", "state.json"), "{}\n");
+commit(tab);
+gateRun("tab rev", tab, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("tab history", tab, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const child = init("child");
+writeFileSync(join(child, "child.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(child);
+const superRepo = init("ordinary-submodule");
+git(superRepo, "-c", "protocol.file.allow=always", "submodule", "add", "-q", child, "vendor/sub");
+commit(superRepo);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule tree", superRepo, ["--tree-only"]);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule rev", superRepo, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const nested = init("nested");
+writeFileSync(join(nested, "top.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const inner = join(nested, "inner");
+mkdirSync(inner);
+git(inner, "init", "-q", "-b", "main");
+writeFileSync(join(inner, "inside.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("untracked nested tree", nested, ["--tree-only"]);
+
+const hist = init("history");
+writeFileSync(join(hist, "gone.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "secp256k1")}\n`);
+commit(hist, "secret old");
+rmSync(join(hist, "gone.txt"));
+commit(hist, "safe head");
+const head = git(hist, "rev-parse", "HEAD");
+const graftPath = git(hist, "rev-parse", "--git-path", "info/grafts");
+writeFileSync(join(hist, graftPath), `${head}\n`);
+gateRun("grafts history", hist, ["--history-only"]);
+rmSync(join(hist, graftPath));
+
+const shallow = join(root, "shallow");
+git(root, "clone", "-q", "--depth", "1", `file://${hist}`, shallow);
+gateRun("shallow history", shallow, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const dupes = init("dupes");
+writeFileSync(join(dupes, "a.txt"), "same\n");
+writeFileSync(join(dupes, "b.txt"), "same\n");
+commit(dupes);
+gateRun("duplicate blobs rev", dupes, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);

+import { mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";

+import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";

+const sh = (cmd: string[], cwd = root) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(cmd, { cwd, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  if (r.exitCode !== 0) throw new Error(`${cmd.join(" ")} (${r.exitCode}): ${new TextDecoder().decode(r.stderr)}`);
+  return new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).trim();
+};
+const git = (repo: string, ...args: string[]) => sh(["git", "-C", repo, ...args]);
+const init = (name: string) => { const p = join(root, name); mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true }); git(p, "init", "-q", "-b", "main"); return p; };
+const commit = (repo: string, msg = "probe") => { git(repo, "add", "-A"); git(repo, "commit", "-q", "--no-gpg-sign", "-m", msg); };
+const gateRun = (name: string, repo: string, args: string[]) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(["bun", "run", gate, "--repo", repo, ...args, "--no-local-store"], { cwd: repo, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  const lines = new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).split("\n").filter((l) => /^(REFUSED:|FAILING:|scanned:|check-no-secrets:)/.test(l));
+  console.log(`${name}: process-exit=${r.exitCode}; ${lines.join(" | ")}`);
+};

+import { mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
+import { join } from "node:path";
+import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
+import { encodeSeed } from "ripple-address-codec";

+const sh = (cmd: string[], cwd = root) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(cmd, { cwd, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  if (r.exitCode !== 0) throw new Error(`${cmd.join(" ")} (${r.exitCode}): ${new TextDecoder().decode(r.stderr)}`);

+const commit = (repo: string, msg = "probe") => { git(repo, "add", "-A"); git(repo, "commit", "-q", "--no-gpg-sign", "-m", msg); };
+const gateRun = (name: string, repo: string, args: string[]) => {

+  const lines = new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).split("\n").filter((l) => /^(REFUSED:|FAILING:|scanned:|check-no-secrets:)/.test(l));
+  console.log(`${name}: process-exit=${r.exitCode}; ${lines.join(" | ")}`);
+};

+import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";

+const sh = (cmd: string[], cwd = root) => {

+const commit = (repo: string, msg = "probe") => { git(repo, "add", "-A"); git(repo, "commit", "-q", "--no-gpg-sign", "-m", msg); };

+};
