+import { mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
+import { join } from "node:path";
+import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
+import { encodeSeed } from "ripple-address-codec";
+
+const root = process.argv[2];
+const gate = "$USER_TMP/T/x.ROpM8B/repo/tools/check-no-secrets.ts";
+const env = { ...process.env, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1", GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: "/dev/null", GIT_AUTHOR_NAME: "probe", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME: "probe", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid" };
+const sh = (cmd: string[], cwd = root) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(cmd, { cwd, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  if (r.exitCode !== 0) throw new Error(`${cmd.join(" ")} (${r.exitCode}): ${new TextDecoder().decode(r.stderr)}`);
+  return new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).trim();
+};
+const git = (repo: string, ...args: string[]) => sh(["git", "-C", repo, ...args]);
+const init = (name: string) => { const p = join(root, name); mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true }); git(p, "init", "-q", "-b", "main"); return p; };
+const commit = (repo: string, msg = "probe") => { git(repo, "add", "-A"); git(repo, "commit", "-q", "--no-gpg-sign", "-m", msg); };
+const gateRun = (name: string, repo: string, args: string[]) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(["bun", "run", gate, "--repo", repo, ...args, "--no-local-store"], { cwd: repo, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  const lines = new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).split("\n").filter((l) => /^(REFUSED:|FAILING:|scanned:|check-no-secrets:)/.test(l));
+  console.log(`${name}: process-exit=${r.exitCode}; ${lines.join(" | ")}`);
+};
+
+rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
+mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });
+
+const filterEq = init("filter-equals");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("filter= tree", filterEq, ["--tree-only"]);
+commit(filterEq);
+gateRun("filter= rev", filterEq, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const filterBare = init("filter-bare");
+git(filterBare, "config", "filter.set.clean", "sed 's/.*/SAFE/'");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter\n");
+const filteredSeed = encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, "payload.txt"), `${filteredSeed}\n`);
+console.log(`bare filter check-attr: ${git(filterBare, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+commit(filterBare);
+console.log(`bare filter committed payload: ${git(filterBare, "show", "HEAD:payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("bare filter rev", filterBare, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const attrComment = init("attr-comment");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, ".gitattributes"), "# Documentation example: *.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(attrComment);
+console.log(`comment check-attr: ${git(attrComment, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("comment-only attribute rev", attrComment, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const replace = init("replace");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519")}\n`);
+commit(replace);
+const original = git(replace, "rev-parse", "HEAD:f.txt");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const safe = git(replace, "hash-object", "-w", "f.txt");
+git(replace, "replace", original, safe);
+gateRun("replace rev", replace, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("replace history", replace, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const tab = init("tab");
+mkdirSync(join(tab, "a\tb"));
+writeFileSync(join(tab, "a\tb", "state.json"), "{}\n");
+commit(tab);
+gateRun("tab rev", tab, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("tab history", tab, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const child = init("child");
+writeFileSync(join(child, "child.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(child);
+const superRepo = init("ordinary-submodule");
+git(superRepo, "-c", "protocol.file.allow=always", "submodule", "add", "-q", child, "vendor/sub");
+commit(superRepo);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule tree", superRepo, ["--tree-only"]);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule rev", superRepo, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const nested = init("nested");
+writeFileSync(join(nested, "top.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const inner = join(nested, "inner");
+mkdirSync(inner);
+git(inner, "init", "-q", "-b", "main");
+writeFileSync(join(inner, "inside.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("untracked nested tree", nested, ["--tree-only"]);
+
+const hist = init("history");
+writeFileSync(join(hist, "gone.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "secp256k1")}\n`);
+commit(hist, "secret old");
+rmSync(join(hist, "gone.txt"));
+commit(hist, "safe head");
+const head = git(hist, "rev-parse", "HEAD");
+const graftPath = git(hist, "rev-parse", "--git-path", "info/grafts");
+writeFileSync(join(hist, graftPath), `${head}\n`);
+gateRun("grafts history", hist, ["--history-only"]);
+rmSync(join(hist, graftPath));
+
+const shallow = join(root, "shallow");
+git(root, "clone", "-q", "--depth", "1", `file://${hist}`, shallow);
+gateRun("shallow history", shallow, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const dupes = init("dupes");
+writeFileSync(join(dupes, "a.txt"), "same\n");
+writeFileSync(join(dupes, "b.txt"), "same\n");
+commit(dupes);
+gateRun("duplicate blobs rev", dupes, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);

+import { mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
+import { join } from "node:path";
+import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
+import { encodeSeed } from "ripple-address-codec";
+
+const root = process.argv[2];
+const gate = "$USER_TMP/T/x.ROpM8B/repo/tools/check-no-secrets.ts";
+const env = { ...process.env, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1", GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: "/dev/null", GIT_AUTHOR_NAME: "probe", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME: "probe", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid" };
+const sh = (cmd: string[], cwd = root) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(cmd, { cwd, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  if (r.exitCode !== 0) throw new Error(`${cmd.join(" ")} (${r.exitCode}): ${new TextDecoder().decode(r.stderr)}`);
+  return new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).trim();
+};
+const git = (repo: string, ...args: string[]) => sh(["git", "-C", repo, ...args]);
+const init = (name: string) => { const p = join(root, name); mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true }); git(p, "init", "-q", "-b", "main"); return p; };
+const commit = (repo: string, msg = "probe") => { git(repo, "add", "-A"); git(repo, "commit", "-q", "--no-gpg-sign", "-m", msg); };
+const gateRun = (name: string, repo: string, args: string[]) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(["bun", "run", gate, "--repo", repo, ...args, "--no-local-store"], { cwd: repo, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  const lines = new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).split("\n").filter((l) => /^(REFUSED:|FAILING:|scanned:|check-no-secrets:)/.test(l));
+  console.log(`${name}: process-exit=${r.exitCode}; ${lines.join(" | ")}`);
+};
+
+rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
+mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });
+
+const filterEq = init("filter-equals");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("filter= tree", filterEq, ["--tree-only"]);
+commit(filterEq);
+gateRun("filter= rev", filterEq, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const filterBare = init("filter-bare");
+git(filterBare, "config", "filter.set.clean", "sed 's/.*/SAFE/'");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter\n");
+const filteredSeed = encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, "payload.txt"), `${filteredSeed}\n`);
+console.log(`bare filter check-attr: ${git(filterBare, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+commit(filterBare);
+console.log(`bare filter committed payload: ${git(filterBare, "show", "HEAD:payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("bare filter rev", filterBare, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const attrComment = init("attr-comment");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, ".gitattributes"), "# Documentation example: *.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(attrComment);
+console.log(`comment check-attr: ${git(attrComment, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("comment-only attribute rev", attrComment, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const replace = init("replace");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519")}\n`);
+commit(replace);
+const original = git(replace, "rev-parse", "HEAD:f.txt");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const safe = git(replace, "hash-object", "-w", "f.txt");
+git(replace, "replace", original, safe);
+gateRun("replace rev", replace, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("replace history", replace, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const tab = init("tab");
+mkdirSync(join(tab, "a\tb"));
+writeFileSync(join(tab, "a\tb", "state.json"), "{}\n");
+commit(tab);
+gateRun("tab rev", tab, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("tab history", tab, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const child = init("child");
+writeFileSync(join(child, "child.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(child);
+const superRepo = init("ordinary-submodule");
+git(superRepo, "-c", "protocol.file.allow=always", "submodule", "add", "-q", child, "vendor/sub");
+commit(superRepo);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule tree", superRepo, ["--tree-only"]);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule rev", superRepo, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const nested = init("nested");
+writeFileSync(join(nested, "top.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const inner = join(nested, "inner");
+mkdirSync(inner);
+git(inner, "init", "-q", "-b", "main");
+writeFileSync(join(inner, "inside.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("untracked nested tree", nested, ["--tree-only"]);
+
+const hist = init("history");
+writeFileSync(join(hist, "gone.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "secp256k1")}\n`);
+commit(hist, "secret old");
+rmSync(join(hist, "gone.txt"));
+commit(hist, "safe head");
+const head = git(hist, "rev-parse", "HEAD");
+const graftPath = git(hist, "rev-parse", "--git-path", "info/grafts");
+writeFileSync(join(hist, graftPath), `${head}\n`);
+gateRun("grafts history", hist, ["--history-only"]);
+rmSync(join(hist, graftPath));
+
+const shallow = join(root, "shallow");
+git(root, "clone", "-q", "--depth", "1", `file://${hist}`, shallow);
+gateRun("shallow history", shallow, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const dupes = init("dupes");
+writeFileSync(join(dupes, "a.txt"), "same\n");
+writeFileSync(join(dupes, "b.txt"), "same\n");
+commit(dupes);
+gateRun("duplicate blobs rev", dupes, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);

+import { mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
+import { join } from "node:path";
+import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
+import { encodeSeed } from "ripple-address-codec";
+
+const root = process.argv[2];
+const gate = "$USER_TMP/T/x.ROpM8B/repo/tools/check-no-secrets.ts";
+const env = { ...process.env, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1", GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: "/dev/null", GIT_AUTHOR_NAME: "probe", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME: "probe", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid" };
+const sh = (cmd: string[], cwd = root) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(cmd, { cwd, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  if (r.exitCode !== 0) throw new Error(`${cmd.join(" ")} (${r.exitCode}): ${new TextDecoder().decode(r.stderr)}`);
+  return new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).trim();
+};
+const git = (repo: string, ...args: string[]) => sh(["git", "-C", repo, ...args]);
+const init = (name: string) => { const p = join(root, name); mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true }); git(p, "init", "-q", "-b", "main"); return p; };
+const commit = (repo: string, msg = "probe") => { git(repo, "add", "-A"); git(repo, "commit", "-q", "--no-gpg-sign", "-m", msg); };
+const gateRun = (name: string, repo: string, args: string[]) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(["bun", "run", gate, "--repo", repo, ...args, "--no-local-store"], { cwd: repo, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  const lines = new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).split("\n").filter((l) => /^(REFUSED:|FAILING:|scanned:|check-no-secrets:)/.test(l));
+  console.log(`${name}: process-exit=${r.exitCode}; ${lines.join(" | ")}`);
+};
+
+rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
+mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });
+
+const filterEq = init("filter-equals");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("filter= tree", filterEq, ["--tree-only"]);
+commit(filterEq);
+gateRun("filter= rev", filterEq, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const filterBare = init("filter-bare");
+git(filterBare, "config", "filter.set.clean", "sed 's/.*/SAFE/'");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter\n");
+const filteredSeed = encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, "payload.txt"), `${filteredSeed}\n`);
+console.log(`bare filter check-attr: ${git(filterBare, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+commit(filterBare);
+console.log(`bare filter committed payload: ${git(filterBare, "show", "HEAD:payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("bare filter rev", filterBare, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const attrComment = init("attr-comment");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, ".gitattributes"), "# Documentation example: *.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(attrComment);
+console.log(`comment check-attr: ${git(attrComment, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("comment-only attribute rev", attrComment, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const replace = init("replace");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519")}\n`);
+commit(replace);
+const original = git(replace, "rev-parse", "HEAD:f.txt");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const safe = git(replace, "hash-object", "-w", "f.txt");
+git(replace, "replace", original, safe);
+gateRun("replace rev", replace, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("replace history", replace, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const tab = init("tab");
+mkdirSync(join(tab, "a\tb"));
+writeFileSync(join(tab, "a\tb", "state.json"), "{}\n");
+commit(tab);
+gateRun("tab rev", tab, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("tab history", tab, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const child = init("child");
+writeFileSync(join(child, "child.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(child);
+const superRepo = init("ordinary-submodule");
+git(superRepo, "-c", "protocol.file.allow=always", "submodule", "add", "-q", child, "vendor/sub");
+commit(superRepo);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule tree", superRepo, ["--tree-only"]);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule rev", superRepo, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const nested = init("nested");
+writeFileSync(join(nested, "top.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const inner = join(nested, "inner");
+mkdirSync(inner);
+git(inner, "init", "-q", "-b", "main");
+writeFileSync(join(inner, "inside.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("untracked nested tree", nested, ["--tree-only"]);
+
+const hist = init("history");
+writeFileSync(join(hist, "gone.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "secp256k1")}\n`);
+commit(hist, "secret old");
+rmSync(join(hist, "gone.txt"));
+commit(hist, "safe head");
+const head = git(hist, "rev-parse", "HEAD");
+const graftPath = git(hist, "rev-parse", "--git-path", "info/grafts");
+writeFileSync(join(hist, graftPath), `${head}\n`);
+gateRun("grafts history", hist, ["--history-only"]);
+rmSync(join(hist, graftPath));
+
+const shallow = join(root, "shallow");
+git(root, "clone", "-q", "--depth", "1", `file://${hist}`, shallow);
+gateRun("shallow history", shallow, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const dupes = init("dupes");
+writeFileSync(join(dupes, "a.txt"), "same\n");
+writeFileSync(join(dupes, "b.txt"), "same\n");
+commit(dupes);
+gateRun("duplicate blobs rev", dupes, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);

+  if (u.kind !== "file") continue;

+    const run = m[0];

+      const s = run.slice(i, i + n);
+      if (s.length === n && decodeSeedLike(s)?.checksumOk) seeds.add(s);
+    }
+  }

+import { mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
+import { join } from "node:path";
+import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
+import { encodeSeed } from "ripple-address-codec";
+
+const root = process.argv[2];
+const gate = "$USER_TMP/T/x.ROpM8B/repo/tools/check-no-secrets.ts";
+const env = { ...process.env, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1", GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: "/dev/null", GIT_AUTHOR_NAME: "probe", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME: "probe", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid" };
+const sh = (cmd: string[], cwd = root) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(cmd, { cwd, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  if (r.exitCode !== 0) throw new Error(`${cmd.join(" ")} (${r.exitCode}): ${new TextDecoder().decode(r.stderr)}`);
+  return new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).trim();
+};
+const git = (repo: string, ...args: string[]) => sh(["git", "-C", repo, ...args]);
+const init = (name: string) => { const p = join(root, name); mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true }); git(p, "init", "-q", "-b", "main"); return p; };
+const commit = (repo: string, msg = "probe") => { git(repo, "add", "-A"); git(repo, "commit", "-q", "--no-gpg-sign", "-m", msg); };
+const gateRun = (name: string, repo: string, args: string[]) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(["bun", "run", gate, "--repo", repo, ...args, "--no-local-store"], { cwd: repo, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  const lines = new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).split("\n").filter((l) => /^(REFUSED:|FAILING:|scanned:|check-no-secrets:)/.test(l));
+  console.log(`${name}: process-exit=${r.exitCode}; ${lines.join(" | ")}`);
+};
+
+rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
+mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });
+
+const filterEq = init("filter-equals");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("filter= tree", filterEq, ["--tree-only"]);
+commit(filterEq);
+gateRun("filter= rev", filterEq, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const filterBare = init("filter-bare");
+git(filterBare, "config", "filter.set.clean", "sed 's/.*/SAFE/'");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter\n");
+const filteredSeed = encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, "payload.txt"), `${filteredSeed}\n`);
+console.log(`bare filter check-attr: ${git(filterBare, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+commit(filterBare);
+console.log(`bare filter committed payload: ${git(filterBare, "show", "HEAD:payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("bare filter rev", filterBare, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const attrComment = init("attr-comment");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, ".gitattributes"), "# Documentation example: *.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(attrComment);
+console.log(`comment check-attr: ${git(attrComment, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("comment-only attribute rev", attrComment, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const replace = init("replace");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519")}\n`);
+commit(replace);
+const original = git(replace, "rev-parse", "HEAD:f.txt");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const safe = git(replace, "hash-object", "-w", "f.txt");
+git(replace, "replace", original, safe);
+gateRun("replace rev", replace, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("replace history", replace, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const tab = init("tab");
+mkdirSync(join(tab, "a\tb"));
+writeFileSync(join(tab, "a\tb", "state.json"), "{}\n");
+commit(tab);
+gateRun("tab rev", tab, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("tab history", tab, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const child = init("child");
+writeFileSync(join(child, "child.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(child);
+const superRepo = init("ordinary-submodule");
+git(superRepo, "-c", "protocol.file.allow=always", "submodule", "add", "-q", child, "vendor/sub");
+commit(superRepo);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule tree", superRepo, ["--tree-only"]);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule rev", superRepo, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const nested = init("nested");
+writeFileSync(join(nested, "top.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const inner = join(nested, "inner");
+mkdirSync(inner);
+git(inner, "init", "-q", "-b", "main");
+writeFileSync(join(inner, "inside.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("untracked nested tree", nested, ["--tree-only"]);
+
+const hist = init("history");
+writeFileSync(join(hist, "gone.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "secp256k1")}\n`);
+commit(hist, "secret old");
+rmSync(join(hist, "gone.txt"));
+commit(hist, "safe head");
+const head = git(hist, "rev-parse", "HEAD");
+const graftPath = git(hist, "rev-parse", "--git-path", "info/grafts");
+writeFileSync(join(hist, graftPath), `${head}\n`);
+gateRun("grafts history", hist, ["--history-only"]);
+rmSync(join(hist, graftPath));
+
+const shallow = join(root, "shallow");
+git(root, "clone", "-q", "--depth", "1", `file://${hist}`, shallow);
+gateRun("shallow history", shallow, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const dupes = init("dupes");
+writeFileSync(join(dupes, "a.txt"), "same\n");
+writeFileSync(join(dupes, "b.txt"), "same\n");
+commit(dupes);
+gateRun("duplicate blobs rev", dupes, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);

+import { mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
+import { join } from "node:path";
+import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
+import { encodeSeed } from "ripple-address-codec";
+
+const root = process.argv[2];

+const sh = (cmd: string[], cwd = root) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(cmd, { cwd, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  if (r.exitCode !== 0) throw new Error(`${cmd.join(" ")} (${r.exitCode}): ${new TextDecoder().decode(r.stderr)}`);

+const commit = (repo: string, msg = "probe") => { git(repo, "add", "-A"); git(repo, "commit", "-q", "--no-gpg-sign", "-m", msg); };
+const gateRun = (name: string, repo: string, args: string[]) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(["bun", "run", gate, "--repo", repo, ...args, "--no-local-store"], { cwd: repo, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  const lines = new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).split("\n").filter((l) => /^(REFUSED:|FAILING:|scanned:|check-no-secrets:)/.test(l));
+  console.log(`${name}: process-exit=${r.exitCode}; ${lines.join(" | ")}`);
+};

+mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });

+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("filter= tree", filterEq, ["--tree-only"]);
+commit(filterEq);
+gateRun("filter= rev", filterEq, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const filterBare = init("filter-bare");
+git(filterBare, "config", "filter.set.clean", "sed 's/.*/SAFE/'");

+gateRun("bare filter rev", filterBare, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);

+gateRun("comment-only attribute rev", attrComment, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);

+import { decodeSeedLike, revUnits, XRPL_ALPHABET } from "$USER_TMP/T/x.ROpM8B/repo/tools/check-no-secrets.ts";
+const repo = "$USER_TMP/T/x.ROpM8B/repo";
+const runs = new RegExp(`[${XRPL_ALPHABET}]{24,}`, "g");
+const seeds = new Set<string>();
+for (const u of revUnits(repo, "04aa4f3")) {
+  if (u.kind !== "file") continue;
+  for (const m of u.text.matchAll(runs)) {
+    const run = m[0];
+    if (run[0] === "s" && run.length <= 35 && decodeSeedLike(run)?.checksumOk) seeds.add(run);
+    for (let i = 0; i < run.length; i++) if (run[i] === "s") for (const n of [28,29,30,31,32]) {
+      const s = run.slice(i, i + n);
+      if (s.length === n && decodeSeedLike(s)?.checksumOk) seeds.add(s);
+    }
+  }
+}
+console.log(`distinct checksum-valid seeds at 04aa4f3: ${seeds.size}`);

+import { mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
+import { join } from "node:path";
+import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
+import { encodeSeed } from "ripple-address-codec";
+
+const root = process.argv[2];
+const gate = "$USER_TMP/T/x.ROpM8B/repo/tools/check-no-secrets.ts";
+const env = { ...process.env, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1", GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: "/dev/null", GIT_AUTHOR_NAME: "probe", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME: "probe", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid" };
+const sh = (cmd: string[], cwd = root) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(cmd, { cwd, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  if (r.exitCode !== 0) throw new Error(`${cmd.join(" ")} (${r.exitCode}): ${new TextDecoder().decode(r.stderr)}`);
+  return new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).trim();
+};
+const git = (repo: string, ...args: string[]) => sh(["git", "-C", repo, ...args]);
+const init = (name: string) => { const p = join(root, name); mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true }); git(p, "init", "-q", "-b", "main"); return p; };
+const commit = (repo: string, msg = "probe") => { git(repo, "add", "-A"); git(repo, "commit", "-q", "--no-gpg-sign", "-m", msg); };
+const gateRun = (name: string, repo: string, args: string[]) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(["bun", "run", gate, "--repo", repo, ...args, "--no-local-store"], { cwd: repo, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  const lines = new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).split("\n").filter((l) => /^(REFUSED:|FAILING:|scanned:|check-no-secrets:)/.test(l));
+  console.log(`${name}: process-exit=${r.exitCode}; ${lines.join(" | ")}`);
+};
+
+rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
+mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });
+
+const filterEq = init("filter-equals");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("filter= tree", filterEq, ["--tree-only"]);
+commit(filterEq);
+gateRun("filter= rev", filterEq, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const filterBare = init("filter-bare");
+git(filterBare, "config", "filter.set.clean", "sed 's/.*/SAFE/'");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter\n");
+const filteredSeed = encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, "payload.txt"), `${filteredSeed}\n`);
+console.log(`bare filter check-attr: ${git(filterBare, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+commit(filterBare);
+console.log(`bare filter committed payload: ${git(filterBare, "show", "HEAD:payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("bare filter rev", filterBare, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const attrComment = init("attr-comment");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, ".gitattributes"), "# Documentation example: *.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(attrComment);
+console.log(`comment check-attr: ${git(attrComment, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("comment-only attribute rev", attrComment, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const replace = init("replace");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519")}\n`);
+commit(replace);
+const original = git(replace, "rev-parse", "HEAD:f.txt");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const safe = git(replace, "hash-object", "-w", "f.txt");
+git(replace, "replace", original, safe);
+gateRun("replace rev", replace, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("replace history", replace, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const tab = init("tab");
+mkdirSync(join(tab, "a\tb"));
+writeFileSync(join(tab, "a\tb", "state.json"), "{}\n");
+commit(tab);
+gateRun("tab rev", tab, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("tab history", tab, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const child = init("child");
+writeFileSync(join(child, "child.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(child);
+const superRepo = init("ordinary-submodule");
+git(superRepo, "-c", "protocol.file.allow=always", "submodule", "add", "-q", child, "vendor/sub");
+commit(superRepo);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule tree", superRepo, ["--tree-only"]);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule rev", superRepo, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const nested = init("nested");
+writeFileSync(join(nested, "top.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const inner = join(nested, "inner");
+mkdirSync(inner);
+git(inner, "init", "-q", "-b", "main");
+writeFileSync(join(inner, "inside.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("untracked nested tree", nested, ["--tree-only"]);
+
+const hist = init("history");
+writeFileSync(join(hist, "gone.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "secp256k1")}\n`);
+commit(hist, "secret old");
+rmSync(join(hist, "gone.txt"));
+commit(hist, "safe head");
+const head = git(hist, "rev-parse", "HEAD");
+const graftPath = git(hist, "rev-parse", "--git-path", "info/grafts");
+writeFileSync(join(hist, graftPath), `${head}\n`);
+gateRun("grafts history", hist, ["--history-only"]);
+rmSync(join(hist, graftPath));
+
+const shallow = join(root, "shallow");
+git(root, "clone", "-q", "--depth", "1", `file://${hist}`, shallow);
+gateRun("shallow history", shallow, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const dupes = init("dupes");
+writeFileSync(join(dupes, "a.txt"), "same\n");
+writeFileSync(join(dupes, "b.txt"), "same\n");
+commit(dupes);
+gateRun("duplicate blobs rev", dupes, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);

+import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";

+const sh = (cmd: string[], cwd = root) => {

+const commit = (repo: string, msg = "probe") => { git(repo, "add", "-A"); git(repo, "commit", "-q", "--no-gpg-sign", "-m", msg); };
+const gateRun = (name: string, repo: string, args: string[]) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(["bun", "run", gate, "--repo", repo, ...args, "--no-local-store"], { cwd: repo, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  const lines = new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).split("\n").filter((l) => /^(REFUSED:|FAILING:|scanned:|check-no-secrets:)/.test(l));
+  console.log(`${name}: process-exit=${r.exitCode}; ${lines.join(" | ")}`);
+};

+mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });

+commit(filterEq);
+gateRun("filter= rev", filterEq, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);

+import { decodeSeedLike, revUnits, XRPL_ALPHABET } from "$USER_TMP/T/x.ROpM8B/repo/tools/check-no-secrets.ts";
+const repo = "$USER_TMP/T/x.ROpM8B/repo";
+const runs = new RegExp(`[${XRPL_ALPHABET}]{24,}`, "g");
+const seeds = new Set<string>();
+for (const u of revUnits(repo, "04aa4f3")) {
+  if (u.kind !== "file") continue;
+  for (const m of u.text.matchAll(runs)) {
+    const run = m[0];
+    if (run[0] === "s" && run.length <= 35 && decodeSeedLike(run)?.checksumOk) seeds.add(run);
+    for (let i = 0; i < run.length; i++) if (run[i] === "s") for (const n of [28,29,30,31,32]) {
+      const s = run.slice(i, i + n);
+      if (s.length === n && decodeSeedLike(s)?.checksumOk) seeds.add(s);
+    }
+  }
+}

+import { mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
+import { join } from "node:path";
+import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
+import { encodeSeed } from "ripple-address-codec";
+
+const root = process.argv[2];
+const gate = "$USER_TMP/T/x.ROpM8B/repo/tools/check-no-secrets.ts";
+const env = { ...process.env, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1", GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: "/dev/null", GIT_AUTHOR_NAME: "probe", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME: "probe", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid" };
+const sh = (cmd: string[], cwd = root) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(cmd, { cwd, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  if (r.exitCode !== 0) throw new Error(`${cmd.join(" ")} (${r.exitCode}): ${new TextDecoder().decode(r.stderr)}`);
+  return new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).trim();
+};
+const git = (repo: string, ...args: string[]) => sh(["git", "-C", repo, ...args]);
+const init = (name: string) => { const p = join(root, name); mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true }); git(p, "init", "-q", "-b", "main"); return p; };
+const commit = (repo: string, msg = "probe") => { git(repo, "add", "-A"); git(repo, "commit", "-q", "--no-gpg-sign", "-m", msg); };
+const gateRun = (name: string, repo: string, args: string[]) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(["bun", "run", gate, "--repo", repo, ...args, "--no-local-store"], { cwd: repo, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  const lines = new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).split("\n").filter((l) => /^(REFUSED:|FAILING:|scanned:|check-no-secrets:)/.test(l));
+  console.log(`${name}: process-exit=${r.exitCode}; ${lines.join(" | ")}`);
+};
+
+rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
+mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });
+
+const filterEq = init("filter-equals");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("filter= tree", filterEq, ["--tree-only"]);
+commit(filterEq);
+gateRun("filter= rev", filterEq, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const filterBare = init("filter-bare");
+git(filterBare, "config", "filter.set.clean", "sed 's/.*/SAFE/'");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter\n");
+const filteredSeed = encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, "payload.txt"), `${filteredSeed}\n`);
+console.log(`bare filter check-attr: ${git(filterBare, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+commit(filterBare);
+console.log(`bare filter committed payload: ${git(filterBare, "show", "HEAD:payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("bare filter rev", filterBare, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const attrComment = init("attr-comment");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, ".gitattributes"), "# Documentation example: *.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(attrComment);
+console.log(`comment check-attr: ${git(attrComment, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("comment-only attribute rev", attrComment, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const replace = init("replace");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519")}\n`);
+commit(replace);
+const original = git(replace, "rev-parse", "HEAD:f.txt");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const safe = git(replace, "hash-object", "-w", "f.txt");
+git(replace, "replace", original, safe);
+gateRun("replace rev", replace, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("replace history", replace, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const tab = init("tab");
+mkdirSync(join(tab, "a\tb"));
+writeFileSync(join(tab, "a\tb", "state.json"), "{}\n");
+commit(tab);
+gateRun("tab rev", tab, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("tab history", tab, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const child = init("child");
+writeFileSync(join(child, "child.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(child);
+const superRepo = init("ordinary-submodule");
+git(superRepo, "-c", "protocol.file.allow=always", "submodule", "add", "-q", child, "vendor/sub");
+commit(superRepo);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule tree", superRepo, ["--tree-only"]);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule rev", superRepo, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const nested = init("nested");
+writeFileSync(join(nested, "top.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const inner = join(nested, "inner");
+mkdirSync(inner);
+git(inner, "init", "-q", "-b", "main");
+writeFileSync(join(inner, "inside.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("untracked nested tree", nested, ["--tree-only"]);
+
+const hist = init("history");
+writeFileSync(join(hist, "gone.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "secp256k1")}\n`);
+commit(hist, "secret old");
+rmSync(join(hist, "gone.txt"));
+commit(hist, "safe head");
+const head = git(hist, "rev-parse", "HEAD");
+const graftPath = git(hist, "rev-parse", "--git-path", "info/grafts");
+writeFileSync(join(hist, graftPath), `${head}\n`);
+gateRun("grafts history", hist, ["--history-only"]);
+rmSync(join(hist, graftPath));
+
+const shallow = join(root, "shallow");
+git(root, "clone", "-q", "--depth", "1", `file://${hist}`, shallow);
+gateRun("shallow history", shallow, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const dupes = init("dupes");
+writeFileSync(join(dupes, "a.txt"), "same\n");
+writeFileSync(join(dupes, "b.txt"), "same\n");
+commit(dupes);
+gateRun("duplicate blobs rev", dupes, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);

+const commit = (repo: string, msg = "probe") => { git(repo, "add", "-A"); git(repo, "commit", "-q", "--no-gpg-sign", "-m", msg); };

+import { decodeSeedLike, revUnits, XRPL_ALPHABET } from "$USER_TMP/T/x.ROpM8B/repo/tools/check-no-secrets.ts";
+const repo = "$USER_TMP/T/x.ROpM8B/repo";
+const runs = new RegExp(`[${XRPL_ALPHABET}]{24,}`, "g");
+const seeds = new Set<string>();
+for (const u of revUnits(repo, "04aa4f3")) {
+  if (u.kind !== "file") continue;
+  for (const m of u.text.matchAll(runs)) {
+    const run = m[0];
+    if (run[0] === "s" && run.length <= 35 && decodeSeedLike(run)?.checksumOk) seeds.add(run);
+    for (let i = 0; i < run.length; i++) if (run[i] === "s") for (const n of [28,29,30,31,32]) {
+      const s = run.slice(i, i + n);
+      if (s.length === n && decodeSeedLike(s)?.checksumOk) seeds.add(s);
+    }
+  }
+}

+import { decodeSeedLike, revUnits, XRPL_ALPHABET } from "$USER_TMP/T/x.ROpM8B/repo/tools/check-no-secrets.ts";
+const repo = "$USER_TMP/T/x.ROpM8B/repo";
+const runs = new RegExp(`[${XRPL_ALPHABET}]{24,}`, "g");
+const seeds = new Set<string>();
+for (const u of revUnits(repo, "04aa4f3")) {
+  if (u.kind !== "file") continue;
+  for (const m of u.text.matchAll(runs)) {
+    const run = m[0];
+    if (run[0] === "s" && run.length <= 35 && decodeSeedLike(run)?.checksumOk) seeds.add(run);
+    for (let i = 0; i < run.length; i++) if (run[i] === "s") for (const n of [28,29,30,31,32]) {
+      const s = run.slice(i, i + n);
+      if (s.length === n && decodeSeedLike(s)?.checksumOk) seeds.add(s);
+    }
+  }
+}

+import { mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
+import { join } from "node:path";
+import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
+import { encodeSeed } from "ripple-address-codec";
+
+const root = process.argv[2];
+const gate = "$USER_TMP/T/x.ROpM8B/repo/tools/check-no-secrets.ts";
+const env = { ...process.env, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1", GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: "/dev/null", GIT_AUTHOR_NAME: "probe", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME: "probe", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid" };
+const sh = (cmd: string[], cwd = root) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(cmd, { cwd, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  if (r.exitCode !== 0) throw new Error(`${cmd.join(" ")} (${r.exitCode}): ${new TextDecoder().decode(r.stderr)}`);
+  return new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).trim();
+};
+const git = (repo: string, ...args: string[]) => sh(["git", "-C", repo, ...args]);
+const init = (name: string) => { const p = join(root, name); mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true }); git(p, "init", "-q", "-b", "main"); return p; };
+const commit = (repo: string, msg = "probe") => { git(repo, "add", "-A"); git(repo, "commit", "-q", "--no-gpg-sign", "-m", msg); };
+const gateRun = (name: string, repo: string, args: string[]) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(["bun", "run", gate, "--repo", repo, ...args, "--no-local-store"], { cwd: repo, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  const lines = new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).split("\n").filter((l) => /^(REFUSED:|FAILING:|scanned:|check-no-secrets:)/.test(l));
+  console.log(`${name}: process-exit=${r.exitCode}; ${lines.join(" | ")}`);
+};
+
+rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
+mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });
+
+const filterEq = init("filter-equals");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("filter= tree", filterEq, ["--tree-only"]);
+commit(filterEq);
+gateRun("filter= rev", filterEq, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const filterBare = init("filter-bare");
+git(filterBare, "config", "filter.set.clean", "sed 's/.*/SAFE/'");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter\n");
+const filteredSeed = encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, "payload.txt"), `${filteredSeed}\n`);
+console.log(`bare filter check-attr: ${git(filterBare, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+commit(filterBare);
+console.log(`bare filter committed payload: ${git(filterBare, "show", "HEAD:payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("bare filter rev", filterBare, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const attrComment = init("attr-comment");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, ".gitattributes"), "# Documentation example: *.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(attrComment);
+console.log(`comment check-attr: ${git(attrComment, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("comment-only attribute rev", attrComment, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const replace = init("replace");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519")}\n`);
+commit(replace);
+const original = git(replace, "rev-parse", "HEAD:f.txt");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const safe = git(replace, "hash-object", "-w", "f.txt");
+git(replace, "replace", original, safe);
+gateRun("replace rev", replace, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("replace history", replace, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const tab = init("tab");
+mkdirSync(join(tab, "a\tb"));
+writeFileSync(join(tab, "a\tb", "state.json"), "{}\n");
+commit(tab);
+gateRun("tab rev", tab, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("tab history", tab, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const child = init("child");
+writeFileSync(join(child, "child.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(child);
+const superRepo = init("ordinary-submodule");
+git(superRepo, "-c", "protocol.file.allow=always", "submodule", "add", "-q", child, "vendor/sub");
+commit(superRepo);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule tree", superRepo, ["--tree-only"]);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule rev", superRepo, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const nested = init("nested");
+writeFileSync(join(nested, "top.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const inner = join(nested, "inner");
+mkdirSync(inner);
+git(inner, "init", "-q", "-b", "main");
+writeFileSync(join(inner, "inside.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("untracked nested tree", nested, ["--tree-only"]);
+
+const hist = init("history");
+writeFileSync(join(hist, "gone.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "secp256k1")}\n`);
+commit(hist, "secret old");
+rmSync(join(hist, "gone.txt"));
+commit(hist, "safe head");
+const head = git(hist, "rev-parse", "HEAD");
+const graftPath = git(hist, "rev-parse", "--git-path", "info/grafts");
+writeFileSync(join(hist, graftPath), `${head}\n`);
+gateRun("grafts history", hist, ["--history-only"]);
+rmSync(join(hist, graftPath));
+
+const shallow = join(root, "shallow");
+git(root, "clone", "-q", "--depth", "1", `file://${hist}`, shallow);
+gateRun("shallow history", shallow, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const dupes = init("dupes");
+writeFileSync(join(dupes, "a.txt"), "same\n");
+writeFileSync(join(dupes, "b.txt"), "same\n");
+commit(dupes);
+gateRun("duplicate blobs rev", dupes, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);

+import { mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
+import { join } from "node:path";
+import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
+import { encodeSeed } from "ripple-address-codec";
+
+const root = process.argv[2];
+const gate = "$USER_TMP/T/x.ROpM8B/repo/tools/check-no-secrets.ts";
+const env = { ...process.env, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1", GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: "/dev/null", GIT_AUTHOR_NAME: "probe", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME: "probe", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid" };
+const sh = (cmd: string[], cwd = root) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(cmd, { cwd, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  if (r.exitCode !== 0) throw new Error(`${cmd.join(" ")} (${r.exitCode}): ${new TextDecoder().decode(r.stderr)}`);
+  return new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).trim();
+};
+const git = (repo: string, ...args: string[]) => sh(["git", "-C", repo, ...args]);
+const init = (name: string) => { const p = join(root, name); mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true }); git(p, "init", "-q", "-b", "main"); return p; };
+const commit = (repo: string, msg = "probe") => { git(repo, "add", "-A"); git(repo, "commit", "-q", "--no-gpg-sign", "-m", msg); };
+const gateRun = (name: string, repo: string, args: string[]) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(["bun", "run", gate, "--repo", repo, ...args, "--no-local-store"], { cwd: repo, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  const lines = new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).split("\n").filter((l) => /^(REFUSED:|FAILING:|scanned:|check-no-secrets:)/.test(l));
+  console.log(`${name}: process-exit=${r.exitCode}; ${lines.join(" | ")}`);
+};
+
+rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
+mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });
+
+const filterEq = init("filter-equals");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("filter= tree", filterEq, ["--tree-only"]);
+commit(filterEq);
+gateRun("filter= rev", filterEq, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const filterBare = init("filter-bare");
+git(filterBare, "config", "filter.set.clean", "sed 's/.*/SAFE/'");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter\n");
+const filteredSeed = encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, "payload.txt"), `${filteredSeed}\n`);
+console.log(`bare filter check-attr: ${git(filterBare, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+commit(filterBare);
+console.log(`bare filter committed payload: ${git(filterBare, "show", "HEAD:payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("bare filter rev", filterBare, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const attrComment = init("attr-comment");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, ".gitattributes"), "# Documentation example: *.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(attrComment);
+console.log(`comment check-attr: ${git(attrComment, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("comment-only attribute rev", attrComment, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const replace = init("replace");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519")}\n`);
+commit(replace);
+const original = git(replace, "rev-parse", "HEAD:f.txt");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const safe = git(replace, "hash-object", "-w", "f.txt");
+git(replace, "replace", original, safe);
+gateRun("replace rev", replace, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("replace history", replace, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const tab = init("tab");
+mkdirSync(join(tab, "a\tb"));
+writeFileSync(join(tab, "a\tb", "state.json"), "{}\n");
+commit(tab);
+gateRun("tab rev", tab, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("tab history", tab, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const child = init("child");
+writeFileSync(join(child, "child.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(child);
+const superRepo = init("ordinary-submodule");
+git(superRepo, "-c", "protocol.file.allow=always", "submodule", "add", "-q", child, "vendor/sub");
+commit(superRepo);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule tree", superRepo, ["--tree-only"]);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule rev", superRepo, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const nested = init("nested");
+writeFileSync(join(nested, "top.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const inner = join(nested, "inner");
+mkdirSync(inner);
+git(inner, "init", "-q", "-b", "main");
+writeFileSync(join(inner, "inside.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("untracked nested tree", nested, ["--tree-only"]);
+
+const hist = init("history");
+writeFileSync(join(hist, "gone.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "secp256k1")}\n`);
+commit(hist, "secret old");
+rmSync(join(hist, "gone.txt"));
+commit(hist, "safe head");
+const head = git(hist, "rev-parse", "HEAD");
+const graftPath = git(hist, "rev-parse", "--git-path", "info/grafts");
+writeFileSync(join(hist, graftPath), `${head}\n`);
+gateRun("grafts history", hist, ["--history-only"]);
+rmSync(join(hist, graftPath));
+
+const shallow = join(root, "shallow");
+git(root, "clone", "-q", "--depth", "1", `file://${hist}`, shallow);
+gateRun("shallow history", shallow, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const dupes = init("dupes");
+writeFileSync(join(dupes, "a.txt"), "same\n");
+writeFileSync(join(dupes, "b.txt"), "same\n");
+commit(dupes);
+gateRun("duplicate blobs rev", dupes, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);

+import { mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
+import { join } from "node:path";
+import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
+import { encodeSeed } from "ripple-address-codec";
+
+const root = process.argv[2];
+const gate = "$USER_TMP/T/x.ROpM8B/repo/tools/check-no-secrets.ts";
+const env = { ...process.env, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1", GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: "/dev/null", GIT_AUTHOR_NAME: "probe", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME: "probe", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid" };
+const sh = (cmd: string[], cwd = root) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(cmd, { cwd, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  if (r.exitCode !== 0) throw new Error(`${cmd.join(" ")} (${r.exitCode}): ${new TextDecoder().decode(r.stderr)}`);
+  return new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).trim();
+};
+const git = (repo: string, ...args: string[]) => sh(["git", "-C", repo, ...args]);
+const init = (name: string) => { const p = join(root, name); mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true }); git(p, "init", "-q", "-b", "main"); return p; };
+const commit = (repo: string, msg = "probe") => { git(repo, "add", "-A"); git(repo, "commit", "-q", "--no-gpg-sign", "-m", msg); };
+const gateRun = (name: string, repo: string, args: string[]) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(["bun", "run", gate, "--repo", repo, ...args, "--no-local-store"], { cwd: repo, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  const lines = new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).split("\n").filter((l) => /^(REFUSED:|FAILING:|scanned:|check-no-secrets:)/.test(l));
+  console.log(`${name}: process-exit=${r.exitCode}; ${lines.join(" | ")}`);
+};
+
+rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
+mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });
+
+const filterEq = init("filter-equals");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("filter= tree", filterEq, ["--tree-only"]);
+commit(filterEq);
+gateRun("filter= rev", filterEq, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const filterBare = init("filter-bare");
+git(filterBare, "config", "filter.set.clean", "sed 's/.*/SAFE/'");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter\n");
+const filteredSeed = encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519");
+writeFileSync(join(filterBare, "payload.txt"), `${filteredSeed}\n`);
+console.log(`bare filter check-attr: ${git(filterBare, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+commit(filterBare);
+console.log(`bare filter committed payload: ${git(filterBare, "show", "HEAD:payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("bare filter rev", filterBare, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const attrComment = init("attr-comment");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, ".gitattributes"), "# Documentation example: *.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(attrComment);
+console.log(`comment check-attr: ${git(attrComment, "check-attr", "filter", "--", "payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("comment-only attribute rev", attrComment, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const replace = init("replace");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "ed25519")}\n`);
+commit(replace);
+const original = git(replace, "rev-parse", "HEAD:f.txt");
+writeFileSync(join(replace, "f.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const safe = git(replace, "hash-object", "-w", "f.txt");
+git(replace, "replace", original, safe);
+gateRun("replace rev", replace, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("replace history", replace, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const tab = init("tab");
+mkdirSync(join(tab, "a\tb"));
+writeFileSync(join(tab, "a\tb", "state.json"), "{}\n");
+commit(tab);
+gateRun("tab rev", tab, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+gateRun("tab history", tab, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const child = init("child");
+writeFileSync(join(child, "child.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(child);
+const superRepo = init("ordinary-submodule");
+git(superRepo, "-c", "protocol.file.allow=always", "submodule", "add", "-q", child, "vendor/sub");
+commit(superRepo);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule tree", superRepo, ["--tree-only"]);
+gateRun("ordinary submodule rev", superRepo, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const nested = init("nested");
+writeFileSync(join(nested, "top.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+const inner = join(nested, "inner");
+mkdirSync(inner);
+git(inner, "init", "-q", "-b", "main");
+writeFileSync(join(inner, "inside.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("untracked nested tree", nested, ["--tree-only"]);
+
+const hist = init("history");
+writeFileSync(join(hist, "gone.txt"), `${encodeSeed(randomBytes(16), "secp256k1")}\n`);
+commit(hist, "secret old");
+rmSync(join(hist, "gone.txt"));
+commit(hist, "safe head");
+const head = git(hist, "rev-parse", "HEAD");
+const graftPath = git(hist, "rev-parse", "--git-path", "info/grafts");
+writeFileSync(join(hist, graftPath), `${head}\n`);
+gateRun("grafts history", hist, ["--history-only"]);
+rmSync(join(hist, graftPath));
+
+const shallow = join(root, "shallow");
+git(root, "clone", "-q", "--depth", "1", `file://${hist}`, shallow);
+gateRun("shallow history", shallow, ["--history-only"]);
+
+const dupes = init("dupes");
+writeFileSync(join(dupes, "a.txt"), "same\n");
+writeFileSync(join(dupes, "b.txt"), "same\n");
+commit(dupes);
+gateRun("duplicate blobs rev", dupes, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);

   306	  // ⚠ The previous line counts only when it ENDS in `key:` or `key =`, so the
   307	  // label is the key whose value this line holds. A wider window flagged nonce
   308	  // vectors listed in an array whose NAME contains `sk` (REVIEW-056 adjudication);
   309	  // an array of values under a label is a printed limit instead.
   310	  if (lineStart > 0 && /^[\s"'`]*$/.test(text.slice(lineStart, at))) {
   311	    const prevStart = text.lastIndexOf("\n", lineStart - 2) + 1;
   312	    const m = text.slice(prevStart, lineStart - 1).match(/([A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$.\-]*)["'`]?\s*[:=]\s*$/);
   313	    if (m) wins.push(m[1]);
   314	  }
   315	  for (const win of wins) for (const m of win.matchAll(IDENT)) if (components(m[0]).some((c) => wanted.has(c))) return m[0];
   316	  return null;
   317	}
   318	
   319	/**
   320	 * 58 to 66 hex digits, not exactly 64 or 66: a scalar printed without padding
   321	 * drops its leading zero nibbles, one time in sixteen per nibble (`REVIEW-056`
   322	 * S3-1). A label is still required, so a 60-digit hash fragment alone is not hit.
   323	 */
   324	const HEX_SCALAR = /(?<![0-9A-Za-z])(?:0x)?([0-9A-Fa-f]{58,66})(?![0-9A-Za-z])/g;
   325	const HEX_32 = /(?<![0-9A-Za-z])(?:0x)?([0-9A-Fa-f]{32})(?![0-9A-Za-z])/g;
   326	
   327	export function labelledHits(text: string): Hit[] {
   328	  const out: Hit[] = [];
   329	  const pub = publicScalars();
   330	  for (const m of text.matchAll(HEX_SCALAR)) {
   331	    const label = labelNear(text, m.index!, m.index! + m[0].length, SECRET_COMPONENTS);
   332	    if (!label) continue;
   333	    const v = m[1].toLowerCase();
   334	    const toy = BigInt("0x" + v) < TOY_SCALAR_BOUND ? "a toy scalar below 2^32" : undefined;
   335	    // One byte repeated is guessable from 256 candidates, the same argument as the seed rule.
   336	    const repeated = v.length % 2 === 0 && v.match(/../g)!.every((b) => b === v.slice(0, 2)) ? "one byte repeated" : undefined;
   337	    out.push({ cls: "labelled-scalar", at: m.index!, shown: redact(m[1]), why: `${m[1].length} hex digits labelled '${label}'`, allowedBy: pub.get(v) ?? toy ?? repeated });
   338	  }
   339	  for (const m of text.matchAll(HEX_32)) {
   340	    const label = labelNear(text, m.index!, m.index! + m[0].length, ENTROPY_COMPONENTS);
   341	    if (!label) continue;
   342	    const rule = publicEntropyRule(Uint8Array.from(Buffer.from(m[1], "hex")));
   343	    out.push({ cls: "seed-entropy-hex", at: m.index!, shown: redact(m[1]), why: `32 hex digits labelled '${label}'`, allowedBy: rule ? `public entropy: ${rule}` : undefined });
   344	  }
   345	  return out;
   346	}

   348	const ALNUM = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789";
   349	const rnd = (n: number, alphabet = ALNUM) => Array.from(randomBytes(n), (b) => alphabet[b % alphabet.length]).join("");
   350	
   351	/**
   352	 * Each pattern carries a SAMPLE, built here at run time so this file contains
   353	 * none, and `runControls()` plants every sample (`REVIEW-056` S1-1: only two of
   354	 * ten patterns had a control, so deleting any other passed every check).

   356	export const CREDENTIALS: { name: string; re: RegExp; sample: () => string }[] = [
   357	  { name: "PEM private key", re: /-----BEGIN (?:[A-Z0-9]+ )*PRIVATE KEY(?: BLOCK)?-----/g, sample: () => "-----BEGIN " + "RSA PRIVATE KEY-----" },

   369	  { name: "GitLab token", re: /\bglpat-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}/g, sample: () => "gl" + "pat-" + rnd(24) },

   371	
   372	export function credentialHits(text: string): Hit[] {
   373	  const out: Hit[] = [];
   374	  for (const c of CREDENTIALS) for (const m of text.matchAll(c.re)) {
   375	    // A value ending in sixteen copies of one character is a placeholder, as in
   376	    // `aws_secret_access_key=AAAA…`. A real token does so with negligible probability.
   377	    const tail = m[0].slice(-16);
   378	    const placeholder = c.name !== "PEM private key" && [...tail].every((ch) => ch === tail[0]) ? "a placeholder (its last 16 characters are one character)" : undefined;
   379	    out.push({ cls: "credential", at: m.index!, shown: redact(m[0]), why: c.name, allowedBy: placeholder });
   380	  }
   396	  { rule: "URL-encoded home", re: new RegExp(`%2[Ff](?:Users|home)%2[Ff]${NAME}`, "g") },
   397	  { rule: "Windows home", re: new RegExp(`[A-Za-z]:\\\\{1,2}Users\\\\{1,2}${NAME}`, "g") },
   398	  { rule: "dash-encoded home", re: /(?<![A-Za-z0-9])-(?:Users|home)-([A-Za-z0-9._]+)-/g },
   399	  { rule: "macOS per-user temp", re: new RegExp(`${NOT_URL}(?:/private)?/var/folders/([A-Za-z0-9_+-]{2}/[A-Za-z0-9_+-]{8,})`, "g") },
   400	];
   401	/** User names that identify nobody. Compared case-insensitively. */
   402	export const GENERIC_USERS = new Set(["runner", "user", "username", "you", "yourname", "me", "name", "example", "shared", "alice", "bob"]);
   403	
   404	export function pathHits(text: string): Hit[] {
   405	  const out: Hit[] = [];
   406	  for (const { rule, re } of PATH_RULES) {
   407	    for (const m of text.matchAll(re)) {
   408	      const who = m[1];
   409	      const generic = rule !== "macOS per-user temp" && GENERIC_USERS.has(who.toLowerCase());
   410	      out.push({ cls: "personal-path", at: m.index!, len: m[0].length, shown: `${rule}: ${redact(who)}`, why: rule, allowedBy: generic ? "generic user name" : undefined });
   411	    }
   412	  }
   413	  return out;
   414	}
   620	 * A `filter` attribute means `git add` stores bytes a clean filter produced, or,
   621	 * for Git LFS, a pointer while the content is published elsewhere. A
   622	 * `working-tree-encoding` attribute re-encodes on the way in. A gitlink or a
   623	 * nested repository publishes none of its content here. In each case the bytes
   624	 * on disk are not the bytes published, so the gate refuses rather than scanning
   625	 * the wrong ones. `git check-attr` reads `.gitattributes`, `.git/info/attributes`
   626	 * and `core.attributesFile` alike.
   627	 */
   628	function refuseTransformedTree(repo: string, paths: string[], gitlinks: string[]): void {
   629	  if (gitlinks.length) throw new Error(`a submodule or nested repository at ${gitlinks.slice(0, 5).join(", ")}: its content is another repository and is not scanned`);
   630	  if (!paths.length) return;
   631	  const out = gitText(repo, ["check-attr", "-z", "--stdin", "filter", "working-tree-encoding"], paths.join("\0") + "\0").split("\0");
   632	  const bad: string[] = [];
   633	  for (let i = 0; i + 2 < out.length; i += 3) if (out[i + 2] !== "unspecified" && out[i + 2] !== "unset") bad.push(`${out[i]} (${out[i + 1]}=${out[i + 2]})`);
   634	  if (bad.length) throw new Error(`content-transforming attributes on ${bad.length} path(s), e.g. ${bad.slice(0, 3).join(", ")}: the published bytes are not the bytes on disk`);
   635	}
   636	
   637	/** What `git add -A` would commit, read from disk. Symlinks are not followed. */
   638	export function treeUnits(repo: string): Unit[] {
   639	  const names = gitText(repo, ["ls-files", "-z", "--cached", "--others", "--exclude-standard"]).split("\0").filter(Boolean);
   640	  const staged = gitText(repo, ["ls-files", "-z", "-s"]).split("\0").filter(Boolean);
   641	  const gitlinks = staged.filter((l) => l.startsWith("160000 ")).map((l) => l.slice(l.indexOf("\t") + 1));
   642	  // An untracked nested repository is listed as a directory: `git add -A` would record a gitlink.
   643	  gitlinks.push(...names.filter((n) => n.endsWith("/")));
   644	  refuseTransformedTree(repo, names.filter((n) => !n.endsWith("/")), gitlinks);
   645	  const units: Unit[] = [];
   646	  for (const n of [...new Set(names)]) {
   647	    const p = join(repo, n);
   648	    units.push({ where: n, text: n, scope: "tree", kind: "path" });
   649	    if (!existsSync(p) && !lstatSync(p, { throwIfNoEntry: false })) {
   650	      // Deleted on disk, still in the index: the index copy is what a plain commit publishes.
   651	      try { units.push({ where: n, text: asText(git(repo, ["cat-file", "blob", `:${n}`])), scope: "tree", kind: "file" }); } catch { /* not in index either */ }
   652	      continue;
   653	    }
   654	    const s = lstatSync(p);
   655	    if (s.isSymbolicLink()) units.push({ where: `${n} (symlink target)`, text: readlinkSync(p), scope: "tree", kind: "file" });
   656	    else if (s.isFile()) units.push({ where: n, text: asText(readFileSync(p)), scope: "tree", kind: "file" });
   657	  }
   658	  return units;
   659	}

   661	/** Exactly the blobs of one commit's tree. */
   662	export function revUnits(repo: string, rev: string): Unit[] {
   663	  // ⚠ Split at the FIRST tab only: a path may itself contain one (REVIEW-056 S2-3).
   664	  const entries = gitText(repo, ["ls-tree", "-r", "-z", "--full-tree", rev]).split("\0").filter(Boolean).map((l) => {
   665	    const t = l.indexOf("\t");
   666	    const [mode, type, sha] = l.slice(0, t).split(" ");
   667	    return { mode, type, sha, path: l.slice(t + 1) };
   668	  });
   669	  const gitlinks = entries.filter((e) => e.type === "commit").map((e) => e.path);
   670	  if (gitlinks.length) throw new Error(`a submodule at ${gitlinks.slice(0, 5).join(", ")}: its content is another repository and is not scanned`);
   671	  const blobs = entries.filter((e) => e.type === "blob");
   672	  const pathsOf = new Map<string, string[]>();
   673	  for (const e of blobs) pathsOf.set(e.sha, [...(pathsOf.get(e.sha) ?? []), e.path]);
   674	  const units: Unit[] = blobs.map((e) => ({ where: e.path, text: e.path, scope: "tree" as const, kind: "path" as const }));
   675	  for (const o of batchObjects(repo, [...pathsOf.keys()])) {
   676	    const ps = pathsOf.get(o.sha)!;
   677	    const text = asText(o.body);
   678	    if (ps.some((p) => p === ".gitattributes" || p.endsWith("/.gitattributes")) && /\bfilter\s*=|working-tree-encoding/.test(text)) {
   679	      throw new Error(`content-transforming attributes in ${ps.join(", ")} at ${rev}: the published bytes may not be the blobs`);
   680	    }
   681	    units.push({ where: ps.join("; "), text, scope: "tree", kind: "file", paths: ps.length });
   682	  }
   683	  return units;
   684	}
   685	
   686	/** A commit or tag message, without the identity and signature headers. */
   687	function messageOf(body: Uint8Array): string {
   688	  const t = asText(body);
   689	  const split = t.indexOf("\n\n");
   690	  const head = split === -1 ? t : t.slice(0, split);
   691	  const msg = split === -1 ? "" : t.slice(split + 2);
   692	  // Keep header lines that are not identity or signature: none carry free text
   693	  // except `encoding`, so only the message is returned.
   694	  void head;
   695	  return msg;
   696	}

+import { mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
+import { join } from "node:path";
+import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
+import { encodeSeed } from "ripple-address-codec";

+const root = process.argv[2];

+const env = { ...process.env, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1", GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: "/dev/null", GIT_AUTHOR_NAME: "probe", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME: "probe", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid" };
+const sh = (cmd: string[], cwd = root) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(cmd, { cwd, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  if (r.exitCode !== 0) throw new Error(`${cmd.join(" ")} (${r.exitCode}): ${new TextDecoder().decode(r.stderr)}`);
+  return new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).trim();
+};
+const git = (repo: string, ...args: string[]) => sh(["git", "-C", repo, ...args]);
+const init = (name: string) => { const p = join(root, name); mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true }); git(p, "init", "-q", "-b", "main"); return p; };
+const commit = (repo: string, msg = "probe") => { git(repo, "add", "-A"); git(repo, "commit", "-q", "--no-gpg-sign", "-m", msg); };
+const gateRun = (name: string, repo: string, args: string[]) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(["bun", "run", gate, "--repo", repo, ...args, "--no-local-store"], { cwd: repo, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  const lines = new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).split("\n").filter((l) => /^(REFUSED:|FAILING:|scanned:|check-no-secrets:)/.test(l));
+  console.log(`${name}: process-exit=${r.exitCode}; ${lines.join(" | ")}`);
+};
+
+rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
+mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });

+import { mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
+import { join } from "node:path";
+import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
+import { encodeSeed } from "ripple-address-codec";
+
+const root = process.argv[2];
+const gate = "$USER_TMP/T/x.ROpM8B/repo/tools/check-no-secrets.ts";
+const env = { ...process.env, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1", GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: "/dev/null", GIT_AUTHOR_NAME: "probe", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME: "probe", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL: "probe@example.invalid" };
+const sh = (cmd: string[], cwd = root) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(cmd, { cwd, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  if (r.exitCode !== 0) throw new Error(`${cmd.join(" ")} (${r.exitCode}): ${new TextDecoder().decode(r.stderr)}`);
+  return new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).trim();
+};
+const git = (repo: string, ...args: string[]) => sh(["git", "-C", repo, ...args]);
+const init = (name: string) => { const p = join(root, name); mkdirSync(p, { recursive: true }); git(p, "init", "-q", "-b", "main"); return p; };
+const commit = (repo: string, msg = "probe") => { git(repo, "add", "-A"); git(repo, "commit", "-q", "--no-gpg-sign", "-m", msg); };
+const gateRun = (name: string, repo: string, args: string[]) => {
+  const r = Bun.spawnSync(["bun", "run", gate, "--repo", repo, ...args, "--no-local-store"], { cwd: repo, env, stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe" });
+  const lines = new TextDecoder().decode(r.stdout).split("\n").filter((l) => /^(REFUSED:|FAILING:|scanned:|check-no-secrets:)/.test(l));
+  console.log(`${name}: process-exit=${r.exitCode}; ${lines.join(" | ")}`);
+};
+
+rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
+mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });
+
+const filterEq = init("filter-equals");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, ".gitattributes"), "payload.txt filter=inject\n");
+writeFileSync(join(filterEq, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+gateRun("filter= tree", filterEq, ["--tree-only"]);
+commit(filterEq);
+gateRun("filter= rev", filterEq, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const filterBare = init("filter-bare");

+commit(filterBare);
+console.log(`bare filter committed payload: ${git(filterBare, "show", "HEAD:payload.txt")}`);
+gateRun("bare filter rev", filterBare, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);
+
+const attrComment = init("attr-comment");

+writeFileSync(join(attrComment, "payload.txt"), "SAFE\n");
+commit(attrComment);

+gateRun("comment-only attribute rev", attrComment, ["--rev", "HEAD"]);

## Seam 2 — Added allow rules

### R2-4 — MEDIUM — Repeated-tail allowance can hide a real credential prefix

File: [tools/check-no-secrets.ts:375]($USER_TMP/T/x.ROpM8B/repo/tools/check-no-secrets.ts:375)

For variable-length credential patterns, appending sixteen allowed repeated characters changes a failing credential into an allowed placeholder. The original credential remains recoverable by stripping the suffix.

Wrong output:

```text
token: failing=1 allowed=none
token-plus-tail: failing=0 allowed=a placeholder (its last 16 characters are one character)
```

```sh

const token="xoxb-"+"Ab3-".repeat(6);
for (const [n,v] of [["token",token],["token-plus-tail",token+"-".repeat(16)]]) {
  const h=credentialHits(v);
  console.log(`${n}: failing=${h.filter(x=>!x.allowedBy).length} allowed=${h.map(x=>x.allowedBy).filter(Boolean).join("|")||"none"}`);
}'
```
